a: Velo toch tocho — ka mashma lan.
Amar resh lakish: kane bekumeto shel zav, vehesit bo et hattahor — tahor. kane bekumeto shel tahor, vehesit bo et hazzav — tame.
May tama? deamar kera "vechol asher yigga bo hazzav veyadav lo shataf bammayim" — zehu heseto shel zav, shello matzinu lo tumea bechol hattora kullah.
Veappekeh rachamana bilshon negia, lememra deheyset unegia keyadav, ma hatam meabbaray, af hacha meabbaray.
Aval hazzav uvaal keri enan metammein vechulei. zav — dichtiv "ki yihye zav mibbesaro" — ad sheyyetze zovo mibbesaro, baal keri — dichtiv "veish ki tetze mimmennu shichvat zara".
Haya ochel bitruma vehirgish vechulei. ochez? vehatanya: rabbi eliezer omer: kol haochez baamma umashtin, keillu mevi mabbul laolam!
Amar abbaye: bematlit ava. rava amar: afillu tema bematlit rakka, kevan daakar — akar. veabbaye chayesh dilma ate leosofe, verava — leosofe la chayesh.
Vehatanya: lema ze dome? lenoten etzba baayin, shekkol zeman sheetzba beayin — madmaat vechozeret umadmaat.
Verava, kol ichamome vahadar ichamome beshata — la shechiach.
Amar shemuel: kol shichvat zera sheen kol gufo margish bah enah metammea. may tama? "shichvat zera" amar rachamana — biruya lehazeria.
Metivi: haya mehareher ballayla, veamad umatza besaro cham — tame! targema rav huna: bimshammesh mittato bachalomo, dei efshar leshammesh belo haregasha.
Lishshana achrina, amar shemuel: kol shichvat zera sheeno yore kechetz enah metammea. may ikka ben hay lishshana lehay lishshana? ikka venayyhu: neekra beharegasha veyatza shello beharegasha.
Milleta difshita leh lishmuel, mibbaya leh lerava. devae rava: neekra beharegasha veyatzta shello beharegasha, mahu?
Ta shema: baal keri shettaval velo hetil mayim, lichsheyyatil mayim tame. shane hatam, derubba beharegasha nefak.

Lishshana achrina amri la, amar shemuel: kol shichvat zera sheeno yore kechetz enah mazraat. azroe hu dela mazrea, ha tammoye metammeya, shenneemar: "ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor mikkere" — afillu keri baolam.
Bae rava: goy shehirher, veyarad vetaval — mahu?
Im timtze lomar batar akira azlinan, hane mille lechumera, aval hacha dilkulla — la amrinan, o dilma la shena? teku.
Bae rava: zava shenneekru meme ragleha, veyarda vetavla — mahu?
Im timtza lomar batar akira azlinan, hane mille shichvat zera, dela matze naket la, aval meme ragleha, dematze naket la — la, o dilma la shena? teku.
Bae rava: goya zava shenneekru meme ragleha,
b: Veyarda vetavla — mahu?
Im timtze lomar batar akira azlinan, af al gav dematze naket lehu — hane mille yisreelit ditmea deorayyta, aval goya zava ditmea derabbanan — la, o dilma la shena? teku.
Umetammein bechol shehen. amar shemuel: zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma, shenneemar: "o hechtim besaro mizzovo".
Vehaanan tenan: metammein bechol shehen! hu deamar kerabbi natan, detanya: rabbi natan omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma, velo hodu lo.
May tama derabbi yishmael? deamar kera: "o hechtim besaro mizzovo".
Verabbanan? hahu mibbae leh: lach metamme, veeno metamme yavesh.
Verabbi yishmael? hahu merar" nafka.
Verabbanan? hahu leminyana hu daata: "zovo" — chada, "rar besaro" — tere, "et zovo" — telat, limmed al zav baal shalosh reiyyot shechayyayv bekorban.
"O hechtim besaro mizzovo tame", miktzat zovo tame, limmed al zav baal shete reiyyot shemmetamme mishkav umoshav. verabbi yishmael, minyana mena leh? nafka leh midderabbi simay.
Detanya, rabbi simay omer: mana hakkatuv shetayim ukerao "tame", shalosh ukerao "tame". ha chetzad? shetayim lattumea, veshalosh lakkorban.
Uleman denafka leh tarvayyhu mizzot tihye tumeato bezovo", "ish ish ki yihye zav mibbesaro" may aved leh? mibbae leh ad sheyyetze mibbesaro.
"Zovo tame" lema li? limmed al hazzov shehu tame.
Amar rav chanilay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: shichvat zera — leroe bemashshehu, lenogea bechaadasha. vehaanan "metammein bechol shehen" tenan! may lav lenogea? lo, leroe.

Ta shema: chomer beshichvat zera mibbesheretz, vachomer besheretz mibbeshichvat zera. chomer besheretz — shehashsheretz en chaluka tumeato, ma sheen ken beshichvat zera. chomer beshichvat zera — shehashichvat zera metamme bechol shehu, ma sheen ken besheretz.
May lav lenogea? la, leroe.
Veha dumeya desheretz katane, ma sheretz bingia — af shichvat zera bingia! amar rav adda bar ahava: shum sheretz katane, veshum shichvat zera katane.
Vesheretz la metamme bemashshehu? veha anan tenan: haevarim en lahem shiur, pachot mikkezayit besar hammet, ufachot mikkezayit besar nevela, ufachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz.
Shane ever — dechulleh bimkom adasha kae, deha illu chasar pureta ever — mi kamtamme?
Shichvat zera dachaluka tumeato — may hi? ilema ben yisrael lidgoyim — hachi name ikka achbar deyam veachbar deyabbasha!
Ella, ben katan legadol.
Amar rav pappa: ketannae, minnayin lerabbot nogea beshichvat zera? talmud lomar "o ish".
Ufeligi tannae bealma, deikka deamri: dun minna uminna, veikka deamri: dun minna veoke beatra.
Leman deamar dun minna uminna — ma sheretz bingia, af shichvat zera bingia; uminna — ma sheretz bechaadasha, af shichvat zera bechaadasha.
Uleman deamar dun minna veoke beatra, ma sheretz bingia — af shichvat zera bingia, veoke beatra — ma shichvat zera laroe bemashshehu, af lannogea bemashshehu.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: mimmay demeo ish" desheretz kamrabbe leh? dilma meo ish asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara" kamrabbe leh, udechulle alma dun minna uminna?
Shayylinhu letannae, ikka detane kerav pappa, veikka detane kerav huna bereh derav natan.
Mishna tinoket bat yom echad — mittammea benidda. bat asara yamim — mittammea beziva.
Tinok ben yom echad — mittamme beziva, umittamme bingaim, umittamme bitme met, vezokek leyibbum, ufoter min hayyibbum, umaachil bitruma, ufosel (et) [min] hatteruma,

a: Venochel umanchil, vehahorgo chayyayv, vahare hu leaviv uleimmo ulechol kerovav kechatan shalem.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ishsha" — en li ella ishsha, bat yom echad lenidda minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha".
Bat asara yamim leziva — mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ishsha" — en li ella ishsha, bat asara yamim leziva minnayin? talmud lomar: "veishsha".
Tinok ben yom echad kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ish ish" — ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot ben yom echad shemmetamme beziva, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vehazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva", "lazzachar" — kol shehu, ben gadol ben katan, "lannekeva" — kol shehi, ben gedola ben ketanna. im ken ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
Umittamme bingaim. dichtiv: "adam ki yihye veor besaro" — "adam", kol shehu.
Umetamme bitme met. dichtiv: "veal hannefashot asher hayu sham" — nefesh kol dehu.
Vezokek leyibbum. dichtiv: "ki yeshvu achim yachdav" — achim shehaya lahem yeshiva achat baolam.
Ufoter min hayyibbum. "uven en lo" amar rachamana, veha it leh.
Umaachil bitruma. dichtiv: "vilid beto hem yochlu velachmo", keri veh: "yaachilu belachmo".
Ufosel min hatteruma. "vezera en lah" amar rachamana — veha it la.
May irya zera? afillu ubbar name! dichtiv "kinureha" — perat limubberet.
Utzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "vezera en lah", mishshum demeikkara chad gufa vehasheta tere gufe, aval hacha — demeikkara chad gufa vehasheta chad gufa — ema techol, ketav rachamana "kinureha".
Vei ketav rachamana "kinureha", mishshum demeikkara gufa serika vehasheta gufa malya, aval hacha — demeikkara gufa serika vehasheta gufa serika, ema techol — tzericha.

Kerae ittarutz, ella matnitin may irya "ben yom echad"? afillu ubbar name! amar rav sheshet: hacha vemay askinan? bechohen sheyyesh lo shete nashim, achat gerusha veachat sheenah gerusha, veyesh lo banim mishsheenah gerusha, veyesh lo ben yom echad min haggerusha.
Defosel beavde aviv milleechol bitruma, uleappoke midderabbi yose, deamar: ubbar name posel, ka mashma lan: ben yom echad — in, ubbar — la.
Nochel umanchil. nochel, mimman? meaviv. umanchil, leman? leachiv meaviv. i bae meavu (lerte) [lertu], vei bae minneh (lerte) [lertu]!
Amar rav sheshet: nochel benichse haem lehanechil leechav min haav. vedavka ben yom echad, aval ubbar — la. may tama? dehu mayet beresha, veen habben yoresh et immo
b: Bakkever lehanechil leechav min haav.
Ini? veha hava ovada, ufarkes ad telat pirkuse! amar mar bereh derav ashe: midde dehave azzenav halletaa dimfarkeset.

Mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava amar: lomar shemmemaet bechelek bechora, veamar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava: ben shennolad achar mitat haav eno memaet bechelek bechora, may tama? "veyaldu lo" baenan.
Besura matnu hachi, befumebdita matnu hachi: amar mar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava — bechor shennolad leachar mitat aviv eno notel pi shenayim. may tama? "yakkir" baenan, veha lekka.
Vehilcheta: kechol hane lishshane demar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava.
Vehahorgo chayyayv. dichtiv "veish ki yakke kol nefesh" — mikkol makom.
Vahare hu leaviv uleimmo ulechol kerovav kechatan shalem. lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: leinyan avelut.
Keman? dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: kol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel. ha lo shaha — safek have! hacha vemay askinan? dekim leh shekkalu lo chodashav.
Mishna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad — mitkaddeshet bevia, veim ba aleha yavam — kenaah, vechayyayvin aleha mishshum eshet ish,
Umetammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon.
Nisset lakkohen — tochal bitruma; ba aleha echad min happesulin — pesalah min hakkehunna; ba aleha echad mikkol haarayot haamurot battora — mumatin aleha, vehi petura.
Pachot mikken — kenoten etzba baayin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bat shalosh shanim mitkaddeshet bevia, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad. may benayyhu? amri deve rabbi yannay: erev rosh hashshana ikka benayyhu.
Verabbi yochanan amar: sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana ikka benayyhu.
Metivi: bat shalosh shanim, vaafillu bat shete shanim veyom echad — mitkaddeshet bevia, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad.

a: Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, ki hechi deikka tanna dekaamar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana, hachi name ikka tanna deamar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana.
Ella lerabbi yannay kashya! kashya.
Pachot mikken  — kenoten etzba baayin. ibbaya lehu: hane betulin — mezal azli veatu, o dilma ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ad leachar shalosh?
Lemay nafka minna? kegon shebbaal betoch shalosh, umatza dam, uvaal leachar shalosh velo matza dam. i amrat mezal azli veatu — shehut hu dela havya lehu.
Ella i amrat: ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ad leachar shalosh, ha acher ba aleha — may?
Matkef la rav chiyyay bereh derav ika: uman lema lan demakka shebbetoch shalosh enah chozeret lealtar? shemma chozeret lealtar, veha [vadday] acher ba aleha!

Ella nafka minna, kegon shebbaal betoch shalosh umatza dam, uvaal leachar shalosh umatza dam. i amrat mezal azli veatu — hay dam betulin hu, ella i amrat ittetzode hu dela mittatzdi ella ad leachar shalosh — hay dam nidda hu. may?

Amar rav chisda: ta shema, pachot mikkan kenoten etzba baayin. lema li lemitne "kenoten etzba baayin"? litne: pachot mikkan velo chelum! may lav ha ka mashma lan: ma ayin madmaat, vechozeret umadmaat, af betulin mezal azli veatu.
Tanu rabbanan: maase beyostani, bitto shel asvirus ben antoninus, shebbata lifne rabbi. amra lo: rabbi, ishsha bechamma nisset? amar lah: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad.
Uvechamma mitabberet? amar lah: bat shetem esre shana veyom echad. amra lo: ani nisseti beshesh, veyaladti besheva. oy leshalosh shanim sheibbadti bevet abba!
Umi miabbera? vehatane rav bivi kammeh derav nachman: shalosh nashim meshammeshot bemoch — ketanna, meubberet, umenika.
Ketanna — shemma titabber vetamut; meubberet — shemma taase ubbarah sandal; menika — shemma tigmol et benah veyamut.
Veezohi ketanna? mibbat achat esre shana veyom echad vead shetem esre shana veyom echad. pachot mikkan, o yater al ken — meshammeshet [kedarkah] veholechet, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: achat zo veachat zo meshammeshet kedarkah veholechet, umin hashshamayim yerachamu, shenneemar "shomer petayim Adonai"!
Ibbaet ema: "asher besar chamorim besaram", veibbaet ema: "asher pihem dibber shav viminam yemin shaker".
Tanu rabbanan: maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva, amra lo: rabbi, nivalti betoch shalosh shanim, ma ani lichhunna? amar lah: keshera at lakkehunna.
Amra lo: rabbi, emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? letinok shettamnu lo etzbao bidvash, paam rishona usheniyya goer bah, shelishit motztzah. amar lah: im ken, pesula at lakkehunna.

Raa hattalmidim mistakkelim ze baze, amar lahem: lama haddavar kashe beenechem? [amru lo]: keshem shekkol hattora halacha lemoshe missinay, kach pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim keshera lakkehunna halacha lemoshe missinay. veaf rabbi akiva lo amarah ella lechadded bah et hattalmidim.
Mishna ben tesha shanim veyom echad, shebba al yevimto — kenaah, veen noten get ad sheyyagdil.
Umetamme benidda letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon.
Ufosel, veeno maachil batteruma, ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach, veniskelet al yado, veim ba al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot battora — mumatin al yado, vehu patur.
Gemara velichsheyyagdil. beget saggi la? vehatanya: asu biat ben tesha kemaamar baggadol.
Ma maamar baggadol — tzarich get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikkato, af biat ben tesha — tzarich get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikkato!
Amar rav: hachi kaamar,
b: Lichsheyyagdil yivol veyitten get.
Mishna bat achat esre shana veyom echad — nedareha nivdakin. bat shetem esre shana veyom echad — nedareha kayyaymin, uvodkin kol shetem esre.
Ben shetem esre shana veyom echad — nedarav nivdakin, ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad — nedarav kayyaymin, uvodkin kol shelosh esre.

Kodem lazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru: "yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu", "leshem mi hikdashnu" — en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh. leachar hazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru: "en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu", "leshem mi hikdashnu" — nidran neder vehekdeshan hekdesh.
Gemara vechevan ditna "bat achat esre shana veyom echad nedareha nivdakin", "bat shetem esre shana veyom echad nedareha kayyaymin" lema li? salka datach amena: bodkin leolam, ka mashma lan.

Vechevan detane bat "shetem esre shana veyom echad nedareha kayyaymin", "bodkin kol shetem esre" lema li? salka datach amena: hoil veamar mar "sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvim shana", hecha divdakna sheloshim velo yada lehafelot, ema: tu la livdok, ka mashma lan.
Velitne hane tarte bave: "bat shetem esre shana veyom echad nedareha kayyaymin, uvodkin kol shetem esre". "bat achat esre veyom echad nedareha nivdakin" lema li?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: setama — bishtem esre baaya bedika, beachat esre la baaya bedika, vehecha dechazenan la dacharifa tefe — (mibbadka) [livdeka] beachat esre, ka mashma lan.
Kodem hazzeman hazze veachar hazzeman hazze, lema li? salka datach amena: hane mille hecha dela kaamri inhu, aval hecha dekaamri inhu — nismoch alayyhu, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: ellu divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: devarim haamurim betinoket — betinok amurim, devarim haamurim betinok — betinoket amurim.
Amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi? dichtiv "vayyiven Adonai [elohim] et hatztzela", melammed shennatan hakkadosh baruch hu bina yetera baishsha yoter mibbaish.

Veiddach, hahu mibbae leh lechidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi shimon ben menasya: "vayyiven Adonai [elohim] et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam leishsha vayvieha el haadam" — melammed shekkilleah hakkadosh baruch hu lechavva veheviah etzel adam harishon, shekken bichrakke hayyam korin lekallaita — bannayyta.
Verabbi shimon ben elazar may tameh? amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mittoch shehattinok matzuy bevet rabbo, nichneset bo armumit techilla.
Ibbaya lehu: toch zeman — kelifne zeman, o kilachar zeman?
Lemay hilcheta? i lindarim — lav kelifne zeman damya, velav kilachar zeman damya.
Ella, loovnashin may? rav verabbi chanina deamri tarvavyyhu: toch zeman kelifne zeman, rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi deamri tarvavyyhu: toch zeman kilachar zeman.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, vesimanaych "vezot lefanim beyisrael".
Metiv rav hamenuna: achar zeman hazze, af al pi sheamru "en anu yodim leshem mi nadarnu", "leshem mi hikdashnu" — nidrehem neder vehekdeshan hekdesh. ha toch zeman — kelifne zeman!
Amar leh rava: ema resha — kodem hazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru "yodim anu leshem mi nadarnu", "leshem mi hikdashnu" — en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh. ha toch zeman — kilachar zeman!
Vela hi, rava katae. hu savar rav hamenuna mimmishna yetera kadayek, veaddedayek missefa — leduk meresha.
Vela hi, rav hamenuna miggufa dematnitin ka dayek: ha "leachar zeman" hechi dame? i dela ayyti shete searot — katan hu, ella lav deayyti shete searot,

a: Vetama dilachar zeman hu degamra la lemilleteh? ha toch zeman — kelifne zeman.
Veod metiv rabbi zera: "ish ki yafli lindor neder", ma talmud lomar "ish"? lerabbot ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad, sheaf al pi sheeno yodea lehafeli — nedarav kayyaymin.
Hechi dame? i dela ayyti shete searot — katan hu! ella lav deayyti shete searot, vetama deven shelosh esre veyom echad hu dehave leh "ish", ha toch zeman kelifne zeman! teyuveta.

Amar rav nachman: ketannae, ben tesha shanim shehevi shete searot — shuma, mibben tesha vead shetem esre shana veyom echad — shuma. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: siman. ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad — divre hakkol siman.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: "mibben tesha vead shetem esre shana veyom echad" — shuma, ha shelosh esre shana gufa — siman, vahadar tane: "ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad" — siman, ha shelosh esre shana gufa — shuma!
May lav tannae hi: demar savar toch zeman kilachar zeman, umar savar toch zeman kelifne zeman?
La, dechulle alma toch zeman kelifne zeman, veidi veidi betinoket, veresha rabbi vesefa rabbi shimon ben elazar.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha betinok, veresha rabbi shimon ben elazar vesefa rabbi.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbi, ha — betinok, ha — betinoket. veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbi shimon ben elazar, ha — betinok, ha — betinoket.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: siman. amar rabbi kerusepaday bereh derabbi shabbetay: vehu sheodan bo.
Tanya name hachi: ben tesha shanim veyom echad shehevi shete searot — shuma, mibben tesha vead shetem esre shana veyom echad, veodan bo — shuma. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: siman.

Amar rava, hilcheta: toch zeman — kelifne zeman. rav shemuel bar zutera matne la lishmata derava behay lishshana, amar rava: ketanna kol shetem esre shana memaenet veholechet, mikkan veelach enah memaenet veenah choletzet.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "enah memaenet", alma gedola hi, i gedola hi — tachlotz!
Vechi tema mesappeka leh, umi mesappeka leh? vehaamar rava: ketanna shehiggia lichlal shenoteha enah tzericha bedika, chazaka hevia simanin!
Hane mille bistama, aval hacha divdaku vela ashkachu — la.
I hachi, temaen! choshshin shemma nashru.

Hanicha leman deamar choshshin, ella leman deamar en choshshin, may ikka lememar? deittemar: rav pappa amar: en choshshin shemma nashru, rav pappe amar: choshshin. hane mille leinyan chalitza, aval leinyan meun — choshshin.
Mikkelal deman deamar "choshshin" — choletzet? veha "choshshin" bealma kaamar!
Ella, leolam dela (badkuha) [badkan], uleinyan chalitza chayyshinan, vechi kaamar rava chazaka lemeun, aval lachalitza baaya bedika.
Amar rav dimi minnehardea: hilcheta, choshshin shemma nashru.
Vehane mille hecha dekiddeshah betoch zeman, uvaal leachar zeman, deikka sefeka deorayyta, aval meikkara — la.
Amar rav huna: hikdish veachal — loke.
Shenneemar: "ish ki yafli lindor", velo yachel devaro" — kol sheyyeshno behafelaa yeshno beval yachel, vechol sheeno behafelaa eno beval yachel.
Metiv rav huna bar yehuda (lerava) lesayyoe lerav huna:
b: Lefi shemmatzinu shehishva hakkatuv hakkatan kaggadol lizdon shevua uleissar uleval yachel, yachol yehe chayyayv al hekdesho korban?
Talmud lomar: "ze haddavar".
Katane mihat leissar uleval yachel" chayyayv. ema: leissur "bal yachel".
Issur "bal yachel" — ma nafshach: i mufela samuch leish deorayyta — milka name lilke, vei mufela samuch leish lav deorayyta — issur name lekka, leotan hammuzeharim alav.
Shema minna: katan ochel nevelot — bet din metzvvivyn alav lehaferisho. hacha vemay askinan? kegon shehikdish hu, veachlu acherim.

Hanicha leman deamar: "hikdish hu veachlu acherim — lokin", ella leman deamar: "en lokin" — may ikka lememar? deittemar: hikdish hu veachlu acherim, rav kahana amar: en lokin, rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvavyhu: lokin!
Midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Gufa: hikdish veachlu acherim — rav kahana amar: en lokin, rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: lokin. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: mufela samuch leish deorayyta, umar savar: mufela samuch leish midderabbanan.

Metiv rav yirmeya: yetoma shennadra — balah mefer lah. i amrat bishlama mufela samuch leish derabbanan, atu nissuin derabbanan umevatteli nidra derabbanan; ella i amrat deorayyta, atu nissuin derabbanan umevatteli nidra deorayyta?
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: balah mefer lah mimma nafshach, i derabbanan — derabbanan hu, i deorayyta — katan ochel nevelot hu, veen bet din metzvvivyn alav lehaferisho.
Veha ki gadla achla bahafara kammayyta!
Amar rabba bar levay: balah mefer lah kol shaa veshaa, vehu shebbaal.
Veha en baal mefer bekodmin, kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava, deamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derava: kol hannoderet — al daat balah hi noderet.

Amar abbaye: ta shema, katan shello hevi shete searot, rabbi yehuda omer: en terumato teruma. rabbi yose omer: ad shello ba leonat nedarim — en terumato teruma, mishshebba leonat nedarim — terumato teruma.

Savruha, kasavar rabbi yose: teruma bazzeman hazze deorayyta. i amrat bishlama mufela samuch laish deorayyta — ate gavra deorayyta umetakken tivla deorayyta, ella i amrat derabbanan — ate gavra derabbanan umetakken tivla deorayyta? la, kasavar rabbi yose: teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan.
Vesavar rabbi yose teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan? vehatanya beseder olam: "asher yarshu avotecha virishtah",
Yerushsha rishona usheniyya — yesh lahen, shelishit — en lahen.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: man tena seder olam? rabbi yose.
Rabbi yose tane la, vela savar la. hachi name mistabbera, detanya: issa shennidmea, o shennitchammetza bisor shel teruma —

a: Chayyevet bechalla veenah nifselet bitvul yom, divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda; rabbi yose verabbi shimon potrin min hachalla.

Savruha, man deamar teruma deorayyta — challa deorayyta, man deamar teruma derabbanan — challa derabbanan. i amrat bishlama kasavar rabbi yose challa bazzeman hazze derabbanan, ate dimmua derabbanan umafka challa derabbanan.
Ella i amrat challa deorayyta, ate dimmua derabbanan umafka challa deorayyta?
Vedilma kasavar rabbi yose: teruma bazzeman hazze deorayyta, vechalla derabbanan?

Vechidahdar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri: afillu leman deamar teruma bazzeman hazze derabbanan, challa deorayyta.
Shehare sheva shekkibbeshu, vesheva shechilleku — nitchayyeyvu bechalla, velo nitchayyeyvu bemaaser.

Veamena lehu ana: afillu leman deamar teruma bazzeman hazze deorayyta, challa derabbanan, detanya: i "bevoachem" yachol mishshennichnesu lah shenayim ushelosha meraggelim? talmud lomar "bevoachem" — beviat kullechem amarti, velo beviat miktzatchem.
Vechi assekinhu ezra — la kullehu seluk.
Mishna mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha — "pagga", "bochal", vatzemel". "pagga" — odah tinoket, "bochal" — ellu yeme neureha.
Bezo uvazo amru: aviha zakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha. tzemel — kevan shebbagra, shuv en leaviha reshut bah.

Ezehu simanin? rabbi yose haggelili omer: mishsheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad. rabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyattu haddaddim. ben azzay omer: mishshettashchir happittomet. rabbi yose omer: kede sheyyehe noten yado al haoketz, vehu shokea veshohe lachazor.
Gemara pagga — odah tinoket, kedichtiv: "hatteena chanta faggeha", bochal — ellu yeme hanneurim, keditnan: hatteenim mishsheyyivchalu, veamar rabba bar bar channa amar rav: mishsheyyalbin rashehen.
Veibbaet ema mehacha, "vattiktzar nafshi bahem vegam nafsham bachala vi". tzemel, keman deamar "yatzta melea".

Veezehu simanim? rabbi yose haggelili omer: mishsheyyaale hakkemet. amar shemuel: lo mishsheyyaale hakkemet mammash, ella kede shettachzir yadeha laachoreha, veniret kemi sheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad.
Shemuel bedak beamteh, vihav la arbea zuze deme voshtah. shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: "leolam bahem taavodu" — laavoda netattim, velo levusha.
Shemuel meyayched lehu, rav nachman machlef lehu, rav sheshet masar lehu (laarabey) [learvaye] veamar lehu: izdeharu miyyisrael.
Rabbi yose omer kulei. may "oketz"? amar shemuel: uketzo shel dad.

Tanu rabbanan: ellu hen simane vagrut? rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: mishsheyyitkashkeshu haddaddin. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: mishsheyyachsif rosh hachotem. mishsheyyachsif? azkivna la! ella amar rav ashe: mishsheyyaftzil rosh hachotem. rabbi yose omer: mishshettakkif haatara. rabbi shimon omer: mishshennitmaech
b: Hakkaf.

Vechen haya rabbi shimon (ben yochay) omer: shelosha simanin natnu chachamim baishsha millematta, uchenegdan millemala. pagga millemala — beyadua shello hevia shete searot, bochal millemala — beyadua shehevia shete searot, tzemel millemala — beyadua shennitmaech hakkaf.
May kaf? amar rav huna: makom tafuach yesh lemala meoto makom, kevan shemmegaddelet mitmaech veholech. shaalu et rabbi: halacha kedivre mi? (shelach lehu) [amar lahen]: kedivre kullan lehachemir.

Rav pappa verav chinnana bereh derav ika, chad matne aha, vechad matne achatzer tzorit, ditnan: ezohi chatzer tzorit shechayyevet bemaaser? rabbi shimon omer: chatzer hatztzorit shehakkelim nishmarim betochah.
May "chatzer hatztzorit"? amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan: shekken betzor moshivin shomer al petach hechatzer. rabbi akiva omer: kol sheechad poteach veechad noel — petura.
Rabbi nechemya omer: kol sheen adam bosh leechol betochah — chayyevet. rabbi yose omer: kol shennichnasim lah veen omrim lo "ma atta mevakkesh" — petura.
Rabbi yehuda omer: shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo — happenimit chayyevet, vehachitzona petura.
Shaalu et rabbi: halacha kedivre mi? amar (lehu) [lahen]: halacha kedivre kullan lehachemir.
Mishna bat esrim shana shello hevia shete searot — tavi reaya shehi bat esrim shana, vehi ayylonit — lo choletzet velo mityabbemet.
Ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot — yaviu reaya shehu ben esrim shana, vehu saris, lo choletz velo meyabbem. ellu divre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim: ze vaze ben shemone esre.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hazzachar — kedivre bet hillel, vehannekeva — kedivre bet shammay, shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish.
Gemara ureminhi: echad li ben tesha shanim veyom echad, veechad li ben esrim shello hevi shete searot!
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak, amar rav: vehu shennoldu bo simane saris. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane "vehu saris", shema minna.
Vechi lo noldu lo simane saris, ad kamma? tane rabbi chiyyay: ad rov shenotav.
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, i kechish — amar lehu: "avreyu". i bari — amar lehu: "achchashu", dehane simanim zimnin deatu mechamat kechishuta, zimnin deatu mechamat beriuta.
Amar rav: hilcheta bechulle pirka — meet leet. veulla amar: ditnan tenan, udela tenan la tenan.
Bishlama leulla, hayeynu dekatane hacha "yom echad", vehacha la katane. ella lerav litne!

Veod tane: rabbi yose ben kippar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer, shenat esrim sheyyatzu mimmenna sheloshim yom — hare hi kishnat esrim lechol devareha, vechen hora rabbi belod: shenat shemone esre sheyyatzu mimmenna sheloshim yom — hare hi kishnat shemone esre lechol devareha.
Bishlama derabbi uderabbi yose ben kippar la kashya, ha kevet shammay, ha kevet hillel, ella lerav kashya!
Tannae hi, detanya: shana haamura bakkodashim, shana haamura bevatte are choma, shete shanim shebbisde achuzza.
Shesh shanim shebbeeved ivri, vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat — kullan meet leet.
Shana haamura bakkodashim mena lan? amar rav acha bar yaakov, amar kera: "keves ben shenato", shenato shello, velo shana shel minyan olam.
Shana haamura bevatte are choma menalan? amar kera: "ad tom shenat mimkaro" — mimkaro shello, velo shana shel minyan olam. shete shanim shebbisde achuzza menalan? amar kera: "bemispar

a: Shene tevuot yimkor lach" — peamim sheatta mocher shalosho tevuot bishte shanim.
Shesh shanim shebbeeved ivri menalan? amar kera: "shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit", uvishviit name yaavod.
Shebbabben veshebbabbat, lemay hilcheta? amar rav giddel amar rav: leinyan arachin, verav yosef amar: lefirkin deyotze dofen".
Amar leh abbaye: mi peligat? amar leh: la, hu amar chada, vaana amena chada, vela peliginan.
Vehachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach peligi, man deamar laarachin la amar leyotze dofen, vehaamar rav: hilcheta bechulle pirkin meet leet!
Ella, leman deamar laarachin, may tama la amar leyotze dofen? dumeya dehanach: ma hanach dichtivan, af hane name dichtivan.
Veiddach, hay "shebbabben veshebbabbat" — "shebbazzachar veshebbannekeva" mibbee leh!
Amar rav yitzchak bar nachmani, amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi yose ben kippar, sheamar mishshum rabbi eliezer. amar rabbi zera: ezke veessak veagmar lishmata mippummeh demara.

Ki selek, ashkecheh lerabbi elazar, amar leh: amrat halacha kerabbi yose ben kippar? amar leh: mistabbera amari, middechulleh pirkin tane "yom echad", vehacha la katane — shema minna mistabbera kevateh.
Hadaran alach yotze dofen.
Mishna ba siman hattachton ad shello ba haelyon — o choletzet o mityabbemet.
Ba haelyon ad shello ba hattachton, af al pi shei efshar, rabbi meir omer: lo choletzet velo mityabbemet.
Vachachamim omrim: o choletzet o mityabbemet, mippene sheamru: efshar lattachton lavo ad shello ba haelyon, aval i efshar laelyon lavo ad shello ba hattachton.
Gemara af al pi shei efshar. vahalo ba! "ba" lerabbi meir, "af al pi shei efshar" lerabbanan.
Velitne: "ba haelyon — rabbi meir omer: lo choletzet velo mityabbemet, vachachamim omrim: o choletzet o mityabbemet", vaana yadana mishshum dei efshar hu!
I la tena "af al pi shei efshar", hava amena: rov nashim tachton ate beresha, umiut elyon ate beresha; verabbi meir letameh dechayesh lemiuta, verabbanan letamayyhu dela chayyshi lemiuta.
Vehane mille bistama, aval hecha devadkan vela ashkechan — emar modu leh rabbanan lerabbi meir deelyon kadem.
Ka mashma lan, dei efshar. vadday ate, umintar hu dintar.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach", ella lerabbanan, ippecha mibbae leh! hachi kaamar: kevan sheshshadayim nachonu" — beyadua shessearech tzimmeach".
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv "basot mimmitzrayim daddayich lemaan shede neurayich", ella lerabbanan, ippecha mibbae leh!
Hachi kaamar: kevan shebbau daddayich — beyadua shebbau neurayich, veibbaet ema: may "shede"? kulle bedadde ketiv, vehachi kaamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael:
b: Ikkerafu daddayich — la hadart bach, ishtedo daddayich — name la hadart bach.

Dechulle alma miha attachton samchinan, menalan? amar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: amar kera "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam", hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol ovnashin shebbattora. ma ish besiman echad, af ishsha besiman echad.
Veema: o hay o hay! keish — ma ish tachton velo elyon, af ishsha tachton velo elyon.
Tanya name hachi: amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, kach hayu mefarshin beyavne, veamru: kevan shebba tachton — shuv en mashgichin al elyon.
Tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: benot kerakkim — tachton memaher lavo, mippene shergilot bemerchatzaot; benot kefarim — elyon memaher lavo, mippene shettochanot berechayim.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: benot ashirim — tzad yamin memaher lavo, shennishshof beeppikrisutan. banot aniyyim — tzad semol memaher lavo, mippene sheshshoavot kadde mayim alehen. veibbaet ema: mippene shennosin achehen al gissehen.

Tanu rabbanan: tzad semol kodem letzad yamin. rabbi chanina ben achi rabbi yehoshua omer: meolam lo kadam tzad semol letzad yamin, chutz meachat shehayta bishchunati, shekkadam tzad semol letzad yamin, vechazar leetano.
Tanu rabbanan: kol hannivdakot nivdakot al pi nashim, vechen haya rabbi eliezer moser leishto, verabbi yishmael moser leimmo.

Rabbi yehuda omer: lifne happerek uleachar happerek — nashim bodkot otan, toch happerek — en nashim bodkot otan, sheen massiin sefekot al pi nashim. rabbi shimon omer: af toch happerek nashim bodkot otan, veneemenet ishsha lehachemir aval lo lehakel.
Ketzad? "gedola hi" — shello temaen, "ketanna hi" — shello tachlotz.
Aval en neemenet lomar "ketanna hi" shettemaen, ugedola hi" shettachlotz.
Amar mar: rabbi yehuda omer: lifne happerek uleachar happerek nashim bodkot otan. bishlama lifne happerek bae bedika, dei mishtachchi leachar happerek — shuma ninhu.
Ella leachar happerek, lema li bedika? vehaamar rava: ketanna shehiggia lichlal shenoteha enah tzericha bedika, chazaka hevia simanin! ki amar rava chazaka lemeun, aval lachalitza baaya bedika.
Toch happerek — en nashim bodkot otan, kasavar: toch happerek kilachar happerek (dame).
Uleachar happerek, deikka chazaka derava — samchinan annashim uvadki. toch happerek, delekka chazaka derava — la samchinan annashim vela badki nashim.
Rabbi shimon omer: af toch happerek, nashim bodkot otan. kasavar: toch happerek kelifne happerek, uvaaya bedika, dei mishtachchi leachar happerek — shuma ninhu.
Veneemenet ishsha lehachemir, aval lo lehakel. hay man katane la? ibbaet ema: rabbi yehuda, veattoch happerek.

a: Veibbaet ema: rabbi shimon, uleachar happerek, velet leh chazaka derava.
Mippene sheamru efshar kulei. ha tu lema li? ha tana leh resha!
Vechi tema, mishshum deka vae lemistema kerabbanan — peshita! yachid verabbim — halacha kerabbim.
Mahu detema: mistabbera tama derabbi meir, deka mesayyay leh kerae, ka mashma lan. veibbaet ema: mishshum deka bae lemitne "kayyotze vo".
Mishna kayyotze vo, kol keli cheres shehu machnis — motzi, veyesh shemmotzi veeno machnis.
Kol ever sheyyesh bo tzipporen — yesh bo etzem, veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen.
Kol hammittamme midras — mittamme teme met, veyesh shemmittamme teme met — veeno mittamme midras.
Gemara machnis — pasul leme chattat, ufasul mishshum gistera. motzi — kasher leme chattat, ufasul mishshum gistera.

Amar rav assi, shonin: kele cheres shiuro bechones mashke, velo amru motzi mashke ella leinyan gistera bilvad. may tama? amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: lefi sheen omrim "have gistera legistera".

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad bodkin keli cheres leda im nikkav bechones mashke im lav? yavi areva melea mayim, venoten kedera letochah. im kenasah — beyadua shekkones mashke, veim lav — beyadua shemmotzi mashke.
b: Rabbi yehuda omer: kofef ozne kedera letochah umetzif aleha mayim, veim kones — beyadua shekkones mashke, veim lav — beyadua shemmotzi mashke.
O shoftah al gabbe haur, im haur maamidah — beyadua shemmotzi mashke, veim lav — beyadua shemmachnis mashke.

Rabbi yose omer: af lo shoftah al gabbe haur, mippene shehaur maamidah, ella shoftah al gabbe haremetz. im remetz maamidah — beyadua shemmotzi mashke, veim lav — beyadua shekkones mashke. haya tored tippa achar tippa — beyadua shekkones mashke.
May ikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi yehuda? amar ulla: kinnus al yede haddechak ikka venayyhu.
Kol ever sheyyesh bo tzipporen vechulei. yesh bo tzipporen — metamme bemagga uvemassa uveohel; yesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen — metamme bemagga uvemassa veeno metamme beohel.
Amar rav chisda: davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro, hammakom yihye beezro. etzba yetera sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen — metamme bemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme beohel.
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan: uchesheenah nisperet al gav hayyad.
Kol hametamme midras vechulei. kol dachaze lemidras — mittamme teme met.
Veyesh shemmittamme teme met veen mittamme midras. leetoye may? leetoye sea vetarkav.
Detanya: "vehayyoshev al hakkeli", yachol kafa sea veyashav aleha, o tarkav veyashav alav, yehe tame?
Talmud lomar "asher yeshev alav hazzav" — mi shemyuchad lishiva, yatza ze sheomrim lo: amod venaase melachtenu.
Mishna kol harauy ladun dine nefashot — rauy ladun dine mamonot, veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot veeno rauy ladun dine nefashot.
Gemara amar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer.

Tenena chada zimna: hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot, veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot. vehavenan ba, leetoye may? veamar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer. chada leetoye ger, vachada leetoye mamzer.
Utzerichi, dei ashmeinan ger — mishshum derauy lavo bakkahal, aval mamzer deen rauy lavo bakkahal, ema la.
Vei ashmeinan mamzer — mishshum dekaate mittippa keshera, aval ger dekaate mittippa pesula — ema la, tzericha.
Mishna kol hakkasher ladun — kasher lehaid, veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno kasher ladun.
Gemara leetoye may? amar rabbi yochanan: leetoye some beachat meenav. umanni?

a: Rabbi meir hi, detanya: haya rabbi meir omer, ma talmud lomar "al pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga"? vechi ma inyan rivim etzel negaim? makkish rivim lingaim: ma negaim bayyom, dichtiv "uveyom heraot bo", af rivim bayyom.
Uma negaim shello besome, dichtiv: "lechol mare ene hakkohen", af rivim shello besome. umakkish negaim lerivim, ma rivim shello bikrovim, af negaim shello bikrovim.

I ma rivim bishlosha, af negaim bishlosha? vedin hu: mamono bishlosha, gufo lo kol shekken? talmud lomar "vehuva el aharon hakkohen o el achad mibbanav hakkohanim", ha lamadta sheafillu kohen echad roe et hannegaim.
Hahu samya dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yochanan, dahava kadayen dina, vela kaamar leh vela midde. hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna!
Utenan: kol hakkasher ladun — kasher lehaid, veyesh kasher lehaid veen kasher ladun, veamrinan: leetoye may? veamar rabbi yochanan: leetoye some beachat meenav.
Rabbi yochanan setama acharina ashkach, ditnan: dine mamonot danin bayyom, vegomrin ballayla.
Umay ulemeh dehay setama mehay setama? ibbaet ema: setama derabbim adif, veibbaet ema: mishshum dekatane la gabbe hilcheta dedine.
Mishna kol shechayyayv bammaasrot — mittamme tumeat ovchalin, veyesh shemmittamme tumeat ovchalin veeno chayyayv bammaasrot.
Gemara leetoye may? leetoye basar vedagim uvetzim.
Mishna kol shechayyayv bappea — chayyayv bammaasrot, veyesh shechayyayv bammaasrot veeno chayyayv bappea.

Gemara leetoye may? leetoye teena veyarak, sheeno chayyayv bappea. ditnan: kelal amru bappea — kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulo min haaretz, ulekitato keechad, umachniso lekiyyum — chayyayv bappea.
Ochel — lemaote sefiche setes vekotza, venishmar — lemaote hefker, vegiddulo min haaretz — lemaote kemehim ufitriyyot, ulekitato keechad — lemaote teena, umachniso lekiyyum — lemaote yarak.
Veillu gabbe maaser tenan: kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulo min haaretz — chayyayv bammaasrot, veillu lekitato keechad, umachniso lekiyyum — la katane.
Im hayu bahem shumim uvetzalin — chayyayvin, ditnan: malbenot betzalim shebben hayyarak, rabbi yose omer: pea mikkol achat veechat, vachachamim omrim: meachat al hakkol.
Amar rabba bar bar channa amar rabbi yochanan: uleshin shezzeraan mittechilla livhema, venimlach alehen laadam
b: Tzerichot machshava lichsheyyittalshu, kasavar machshevet chibbur lo shemah machshava.

Amar rava: af anan name tenena, shelosha asar devarim neemru benivlat of tahor, veze echad mehen: tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher. alma machshevet chayyim lo shemah machshava, hacha name machshevet chibbur lo shemah machshava.
Rabbi zera amar: hacha begozal shennafal min harum askinan, dela hava kamman delachshov aleh.
Amar leh abbaye: tarnegolet shebbeyavne, may ikka lememar? amar leh: tarnegol bara hava.
Achichu aleh: tarnegol bara of tame hu, veof tame mi kamtamme? amar lehu abbaye: gavra rabba amar milleta, la techichu aleh, betarnegolet shemmarda, umay "bara"? deibberay mimmara.
Rav pappa amar: tarnegolta deagma havay. rav pappa letameh, deamar rav pappa: tarnegola deagma asir, tarnegolta deagma sharya.
Vesimanaych — "ammoni velo ammonit". darash marimar: tarnegolta deagma asira. chazyuha rabbanan dedarsa veachla, vehayeynu geruta.
Tanu rabbanan: gozal shennafal laggat, vechishshav alav lehaaloto lechuti — tame, lechelev — tahor. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: af lechelev — tame.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: kal vachomer, im metamme tumea chamura shello bemachshava — lo yetamme tumea kalla shello bemachshava?!
Amru lo: lo, im amarta betumea chamura, shekken enah yoredet lechach, tomar betumea kalla, shekken yoredet lechach!
Amar lahen: tarnegolet shebbeyavne tochiach, sheyyoredet lechach, vetimmeuha shello bemachshava. amru lo: mishsham reaya? kutim hayu sham, vechishshevu aleha laachila.
Bemay askinan? ilema bichrakkim, lema la machshava? vehatnan: nivlat behema tehora bechol makom, venivlat of tahor vehachelev bakkerakkim — en tzerichin lo machshava velo hechsher!
Ella bichfarim, umi ikka leman deamar dela baaya machshava? vehatnan: nivlat behema temea bechol makom, venivlat of tahor bakkefarim — tzericha machshava veenah tzericha hechsher!
Amar rabbi zeera bar chanina: leolam bichrach, vegitto measattu, vaasaattu kichfar.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: kal vachomer, im metammea tumea chamura shello bemachshava, lo tetamme tumea kalla shello bemachshava?
Amru lo: lo, im amarta betumea chamura shekken enah yoredet lechach.
May "enah yoredet lechach"? amar rava: hachi kaamri leh: lo, im amarta

a: Betumea chamura shekken enah osa kayyotze bah, tomar betumea kalla sheosa kayyotze bah.
Amar leh abbaye: kol dechen hu, uma tumea chamura dekilla, deenah osa kayyotze bah — metammea shello bemachshava, tumea kalla dachamira, deose kayyotze bah — eno din shemmetammea shello bemachshava?
Ella amar rav sheshet, hachi kaamar: lo im amarta betumea chamura shekken enah tzericha hechsher, tomar betumea kalla shetztzericha hechsher.
Umi tzericha hechsher? vehatnan: shelosha devarim neemru benivlat of tahor: tzericha machshava, veenah metammea ella bevet habbelia, veenah tzericha hechsher!
Nehi dehechsher sheretz la baaya, hechsher mayim baaya.
May shena hechsher sheretz dela baaya, kidtana deve rabbi yishmael? hechsher mayim name la tive, kidtana deve rabbi yishmael,
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua asher yizzarea".

Ma zeraim, sheen sofan letamme tumea chamura, tzerichin hechsher, af kol sheen sofan letamme tumea chamura — tzerichin hechsher. yatzta nivlat of tahor shessofah letamme tumea chamura, sheen tzarich hechsher.
Ella amar rava, veittema rav pappa: shum tumea chamura beolam, shum tumea kalla baolam.
Amar rava: umode rabbi yochanan leinyan maaser, demachshevet chibbur shemah machshava. amar rava: mena amena la? ditnan: hassea vehaezov vehakkornit shebbechatzer, im hayu nishmarin — chayyayvin.
Hechi dame? illema dezarinhu mittechilla laadam — tzericha lememar? ella lav dezarinhu mittechilla livhema, vekatane: im hayu nishmarin — chayyayvin.
Amar rav ashe: hacha bechatzer shealu meelehen askinan, usetama leadam kayymi, vehachi kaamar: im hechatzer meshammeret peroteha — chayyayvin, veim lav — peturin.
Metiv rav ashe: "kol shechayyayvin bammaasrot — mittammein tumeat ovchalin", veim ita, ha ikka hane (dekachayyayvin) [dechayyayvin] bemaaser veen mittammein tumeat ovchalin!
Amar rava: hachi kaamar — kol min shechayyayv bemaaser, mittamme tumeat ovchalin.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: kol shechayyayv bereshit haggez — chayyayv bammattanot, veyesh shechayyayv bammattanot veen chayyayv bereshit haggez.
Veim ita, haikka terefa, dechayyevet bereshit haggez veenah chayyevet bammattanot!
Amar ravina: ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, ditnan: rabbi shimon poter et hatterefa mereshit haggez.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe, ta shema: hammafkir et karmo, vehishkim babboker uvetzaro — chayyayv bapperet, uvaolelot, uvashshichcha, uvappea, ufatur min hammaaser.
Veha anan tenan: kol shechayyayv bappea — chayyayv bammaasrot! ella lav shema minna: min katane, shema minna.
Tenan hatam: modim chachamim lerabbi akiva bezorea shevet o chardal bishnayim ushelosha mekomot, shennoten pea mikkol echad veechad.
b: Veha shevet demichayyayv befea umichayyayv bemaaser, ditnan: kol shechayyayv bappea chayyayv bammaaser.
Umiddechayyayv bammaaser — mittamme tumeat ovchalin, alma: kol mille daavid letama — mittamme tumeat ovchalin, dehay shevet letama avida.
Ureminhi: hakkosht, vehachimmum, verashe vesamim, vehattia, vehachiltit, vehappilpelim, vechallat charia — nikkachin bechesef maaser, veen mittammein tumeat ovchalin, divre rabbi akiva.
Amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri: im nikkachin bechesef maaser, mippene ma en mittammein tumeat ovchalin? veim enan mittammein, af hem lo yillakchu bechesef maaser!
Veamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: nimnu vegamru sheen nikkachin bechesef maaser, veen mittammein tumeat ovchalin.
Amar rav chisda: ki tanya hahi — beshevet haasuya lechamach.

Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmatay kammeh derav kahana, (amar): la tema beshevet haasuya lechamach, ha setama likdera, ella setam shevet lechamach asuya, ditnan: hashshevet mishshennatna taam bakkedera — en bah mishshum teruma, veenah mittammea tumeat ovchalin.

Ha, ad shello natna taam bakkedera — yesh bah mishshum teruma, umittammea tumeat ovchalin. vei salka datach setama likdera — ki lo natna name setama likdera! ella lav shema minna setama lechamach asuya. shema minna.
Mishna kol shechayyayv bereshit haggez — chayyayv bammattanot, veyesh shechayyayv bammattanot veeno chayyayv bereshit haggez.
Kol sheyyesh lo biur — yesh lo sheviit, veyesh sheyyesh lo sheviit — veen lo biur.
Gemara kegon ale halluf shote vehaddandanna, yesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo biur, ikkar halluf shote veikkar haddandanna.

Dichtiv "velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol tevuatah leechol", kol zeman shechayya ochelet min hassade — atta maachil livhemtecha babbayit, kala lachayya min hassade — kalle livhemtecha shebbabbayit, vehane la kalu lehu.
Mishna kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset — yesh lo senappir, veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset. kol sheyyesh lo karnayim — yesh lo telafayim, veyesh sheyyesh lo telafayim veen lo karnayim.
Gemara kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset — dag tahor, yesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset — dag tame. mikkede anan akkaskeset samchinan, "senappir" dichtav rachamana lema li?
I la ketav rachamana senappir, hava amena: may "kaskeset" dichtiv? senappir, vaafillu dag tame — ketav rachamana "senappir vekaskeset".
Vehasheta dichtav rachamana senappir vekaskeset, menalan dekaskeset levusha hu? dichtiv: "veshiryon kaskassim hu lavush".
Velichtov rachamana "kaskeset" vela bae senappir! amar rabbi avahu, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: "yagdil tora veyadir".
Mishna kol hattaun beracha leacharav — taun beracha lefanav, veyesh shettaun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav.
Gemara leetoye may? leetoye yarak. ulerabbi yitzchak dimvarech ayyarak, leetoye may? leetoye mayya.
Ulerav pappa dimvarech ammayya, leetoye may? leetoye mitzvot. velivne mareva dimvarchi batar desalliku tefillayyhu "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lishmor chukkav", leetoye may? leetoye

a: Rechane.
Mishna tinoket shehevia shete searot — o choletzet o mityabbemet, vechayyevet bechol mitzvot haamurot battora.
Vechen tinok shehevi shete searot — chayyayv bechol mitzvot haamurot battora, verauy lihyot ben sorer umore mishsheyyavi shete searot ad sheyyakkif zakan.
Hattachton, velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya.
Tinoket shehevia shete searot, enah yechola leman. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyirbe hashshachor.
Gemara vechevan ditnan "chayyevet bechol mitzvot haamurot battora", "o choletzet o mityabbemet" lema li?
Leappoke midderabbi yose, deamar: "ish" katuv bapparasha, aval ishsha, ben gedola uven ketanna. ka mashma lan, dei ayyti shete searot — in, i la — la. may tama? ishsha keish.
Vechevan ditna "vechen hattinok shehevi shete searot", "chayyayv bechol hammitzvot haamurot battora" lema li?

Vechi tema, mishshum dekavae lemitne "verauy lihyot ben sorer umore", tenena chada zimna: ematay hu ben sorer umore — mishsheyyavi shete searot vead sheyyakkif zakan, hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya!
In hachi name, ella ayyeyde defaresh mille detinoket — kamfaresh name mille detinok.
Tinoket shehevia kulei. amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Umode rabbi yehuda, sheim nivala leachar shehevia shete searot — shuv enah yechola lemaen.
Chavrohi derav kahana sevur lemebad ovada kerabbi yehuda, veaf al gav denivala.

Amar lehu rav kahana: lo kach haya maase bevitto shel rabbi yishmael, shebbat levet hammidrash lemaen, uvenah murekav lah al ketefah, veoto hayyom huzekru devarav shel rabbi yishmael bevet hammidrash, (uvachta) [veravta] bechiyyay gedola bevet hammidrash.
Amru: davar sheamar oto tzaddik, yikkashel bo zaro?

Deamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel mishshum rabbi yishmael: "vehi lo nitpasa" — asura, ha nitpasa — mutteret, veyesh lecha acheret sheaf al pi shello nitpasa — mutteret, veezo zo — shekkiddusheha kiddushe taut, sheaf al pi shebbenah murekav al ketefah — memaenet veholechet lah.
Venimnu vegamru: ad matay habbat memaenet? ad shettavi shete searot. perush, vela avud ovada.

Rabbi yitzchak vetalmidi derabbi chanina avud ovada kerabbi yehuda, veaf al gav denivala. azal rav shemen bar abba amra kammeh derabbi yochanan, azal rabbi yochanan amra kammeh derabbi yehuda nesia, shaddar ballasha veappekuha.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: lo sheyyarbe hashshachor mammash, ella kede sheyyihyu shete searot shochvot, venirot kemi sheyyirbe hashshachor al hallavan. rava amar: shete searot hammakkifot missafa lesafa.
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: shete searot sheamru — tzarich sheyyehe beikkaran gummot. rav malkiyyo amar rav adda bar ahava: gummot, af al pi sheen searot.
Amar rav chanina bereh derav ika: shappud, shefachot, vegummot — rav malkiyyo, belorit, efer mikle, ugevina — rav malkiyya.
Rav pappa amar: matnitin umatnita — rav malkiyya, shematata — rav malkiyyo, vesimana: matnita malketa.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shefachot.

Amar rav ashe, amar li mar zutera, kashe ba rabbi chanina missura: la lishtemit tanna leashmoinan gummot! i ashmoinan gummot, hava amena ad sheyyehu shete searot bishte gummot, ka mashma lan daafillu shete searot begumma achat.

Umi ikka kehay gavvna? vehachtiv "asher bisara yeshufeni vehirba fetzaay chinnam", veamar rava: iyyov bisara cheraf, bisara heshivuhu. bisara cheraf — amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, shemma ruach seara avra lefanecha venitchallefa lecha ben "iyyov" leoyev". bisara heshivuhu — "vayyaan Adonai et
b: Iyyov min hasseara vayyomar" elav: shote shebbaolam, harebe nimin barati berosho shel adam, ulechol nima venima barati lo gumma bifne atzmah shello yihyu shetayim yonkot miggumma achat, sheilmale shetayim yonkot miggumma achat machchish meor enav shel adam. gumma begumma lo nitchallef li, "iyyov" beoyev" nitchallef li?!
La kashya: ha begufa, ha beresha.
Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: shete searot sheamru, afillu achat al hakkaf veachat al habbetzim.

Tanya name hachi: shete searot sheamru, afillu achat begabbah veachat bichresah, achat al gabbe kishre etzbeoteha shel yad veachat al gabbe kishre etzbeoteha shel regel — divre rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon. verabbanan? amar rav chisda: ad sheyyehu shete searot bemakom echad.

Tanu rabbanan: ad matay habbat memaenet? ad shettavi shete searot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyirbe hashshachor. rabbi yose omer: ad shettakkif haatara. ben shelakot omer: ad shettechalkel.

Veamar rabbi shimon: metzaani chanina ben chachinay betzaydan, veamar: kesheatta maggia etzel rabbi akiva, emor lo: ad matay habbat memaenet? im yomar lach: ad shettavi shete searot, emor lo: vahalo ben shelakot heid bemaamad kullechem beyavne ad shettechalkel, velo amartem lo davar!
Keshebbati etzel rabbi akiva, amar li: kilkul ze — eni yodea mahu, ben shelakot — eni makkir, ad matay habbat memaenet — ad shettavi shete searot.

Mishna shete searot haamurot bappara, uvannegaim, vehaamurot bechol makom — kede lachof roshan leikkaran, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi eliezer omer: kede likrotz batztzipporen. rabbi akiva omer: kede sheyyehu nittalot bezug.
Gemara amar rav chisda, amar mar ukeva: halacha kedivre kullan lehachamir.
Mishna haroe ketem — hare zo mekulekelet
Vechosheshet mishshum zov, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en bichtamim mishshum zov.
Gemara man chachamim? rabbi chanina ben antignos hi, detanya: rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: ketamim en bahen mishshum zov. ufeamim shehakketamim meviin lide ziva.
Ketzad? lavsha shelosha chalukot habbedukot lah, umatza alehem ketem, o sheraata shene yamim vechaluk echad — hen hen hakketamim hammeviin lide ziva.
Hasheta shelosha chalukot, delav miggufa kachazya — chayyshinan, shene yamim vechaluk echad mibbaya?
Mahu detema, kol ki hay gavvna mevia korban veneechol? ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: beha zakkinhu rabbi chanina ben antignos lerabbanan, may shena pachot mishshelosha gerisin bemakom echad dela chayyshinan, deamrinan bitre yome chaziteh, shelosha gerisin bemakom echad name nema: tarte ufalga miggufa chazeteh, veiddach aggav zuhama dam maacholet hu.
Verabbanan, kevan deikka lefalloge bigris vaod lechol yoma — la talenan.
Verabbi chanina ben antignos, shelosha gerisin bemakom echad hu dela chayyshinan, ha bishlosha mekomot — chayyshinan. ha amrat: bishlosha chalukot — in, bishlosha mekomot — la!

Ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu, ledidi — bishlosha chalukot — in, bishlosha mekomot — la, ella ledidchu odo li mihat dehecha dachazay shelosha gerisin bemakom echad, deamrinan: tere ufalga miggufa chazeteh, veiddach — aggav zuhama dam maacholet hu!
Verabbanan, kevan deikka lefalloge bigris vaod lechol yoma — la talenan.
Tanu rabbanan: haroe ketem, im yesh bo kede lechallek shelosha gerisin, shehen kigris vaod — chosheshet, veim lav — enah chosheshet.
Rabbi yehuda ben agra omer mishshum rabbi yose: achat zo veachat zo chosheshet.

a: Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra beshello badka, vedivre chachamim beshebbadka.

May "badka", umay "lo badka"? amar rava: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri — hacha vemay askinan? kegon shebbadka atzmah, velo badka chalukah, veaf atzmah lo badka ella ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda, uveven hashshemashot derabbi yose lo badka.
Derabbanan savri beven hashshemashot derabbi yose lelya hu, veha badka beven hashshemashot derabbi yehuda, verabbi yose letameh, deamar ben hashshemashot sefeka have.
Veamena lehu ana: ilmale yadeha beeneha kol ben hashshemashot — yafe attem omrim, achshav shemma im silluk yadeha raata? veamru li: ki kaamrinan keshennatna yadeha beeneha kol ben hashshemashot.
Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra keshello badka. may "lo badka"?
Illema devadka bidrabbi yehuda, velo badka bidrabbi yose, mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar: af al gav devadka betarvayyhu chayysha? ha badka!
Ella peshita delo badka, la bidrabbi yehuda vela bidrabbi yose, aval badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose — la chayysha.
Alma, ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi lelya hu. ema sefa: "vedivre chachamim keshebbadka". may "badka"?
Illema devadka bidrabbi yehuda, velo badka bidrabbi yose, mikkelal derabbanan savri af al gav delo badka betarvayyhu — la chayyshinan, ha lo badka!
Ella peshita devadka ben bidrabbi yehuda, uven bidrabbi yose, aval badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose — chayyshinan.
Alma, ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi sefeka have, kashya derabbi adderabbi!

Hachi kaamar: nirin divre rabbi yehuda ben agra lerabbanan, dela badka kelal — lo bidrabbi yehuda velo bidrabbi yose, sheaf chachamim lo nechleku alav ella devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose. aval hecha delo badka kelal — modu leh.
Ureminhu: haroa ketem, liriyya merubba — chosheshet, liriyya muetet — enah chosheshet. zo divre rabbi yehuda ben agra sheamar mishshum rabbi yose.

Amar rabbi: ani shamati mimmennu sheachat zo veachat zo chosheshet, umin hattaam hazze amar li: uma illu nidda shello hifrisha betohora min hammincha ulemala — lo tehe bechezkat temea? venirin devarav keshebbadka.
May badka? illema devadka bidrabbi yehuda, velo badka bidrabbi yose, mikkelal derabbi yehuda ben agra savar af al gav delo badka la bidrabbi yehuda vela bidrabbi yose — la chayysha? veha lo badka!
Ella peshita devadka ben bidrabbi yehuda uven bidrabbi yose, mikkelal derabbi yehuda ben agra savar: badka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose — la chayysha.
Alma, ben hashshemashot derabbi yose lerabbi yehuda ben agra — lelya hu. kashya derabbi yehuda ben agra adderabbi yehuda ben agra!
Bishlama belo rabbi — la kashya: hatam devadka bidrabbi yehuda velo badka bidrabbi yose, hacha devadka name bidrabbi yehuda uvidrabbi yose, ella bidrabbi kashya!
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi yehuda ben agra: hay tanna savar, shalem ben hashshemashot derabbi yehuda,
b: Vahadar chayel ben hashshemashot derabbi yose, vehay tanna savar, ben hashshemashot derabbi yose meshach shayech bidrabbi yehuda.
Tanu rabbanan: haroa ketem — metammea atzmah vekadashim lemafrea, divre rabbi.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kadashim — metammea, atzmah — enah metammea, shello yehe kitmah chamur meriyyaytah.
Veha matzinu, kitmah chamur meriyyaytah leinyan kadashim!
Ella tane hachi: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af kadashim enah metammea, shello yehe kitmah chamur meriyyaytah lechol davar.
Tanu rabbanan: raata ketem, veachar kach raata dam — tola kitmah biriyyaytah meet leet, divre rabbi.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: yomo. amar rabbi: nirin devarav middevaray, shehu — metakkenah, vaani — meavvevtah.
Metakkenah? auote meavvet la! amar ravina: efoch.
Rav nachman amar: leolam la tefoch, shehu metakken hilchoteha lide ziva,
Vaani meavvevt hilchoteha lide ziva.
Bae minneh rabbi zera merabbi assi: ketamim tzerichin hefsek tohora o la? ishtik, vela amar leh vela mide.
Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev vekaamar: tola kitmah biriyyaytah meet leet, divre rabbi.
Amar resh lakish: vehu shebbadka, verabbi yochanan amar: af al pi shello badka.

Amar leh: mikkelal dichtamim tzerichin (hafesakat) [hefsek] tohora? amar leh: in. veha zimnin saggiin (baa) [beay] minnach, vela amart vela midde, dilma aggav shitfach atya lach? amar leh: in, aggav shitfay atya li.
Mishna haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot — techillat nidda vesof nidda, techillat ziva vesof ziva.
Yom arbaim lazzachar, veyom shemonim lannekeva, ben hashshemashot lechullan — hare ellu toot.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: ad sheattem metakkenim et hashshotot, bou vetakkenu et happikkechot.
Gemara techillat nidda vesof nidda? techillat nidda vesof ziva hi!
Amar rav chisda: hachi kaamar — haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot, techillat nidda vesof ziva.
Uvashshevii leniddatah — sof nidda utechillat ziva.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: ad sheattem metakkenin et hashshotot kulei. hane

a: Shotot ninhu? toot ninhu! ella teni: toot.
Detanya: yom echad tame, veyom echad tahor — meshammeshet shemini velelo immo.
Vearbaa lelot mittoch shemona asar yom. veim hayta roa mibbaerev — enah meshammeshet ella shemini bilvad.
Shene yamim temein, ushene yamim tehorin — meshammeshet shemini, ushenem asar, veshishsha asar, veesrim.
Uteshammesh name bitshasar! amar rav sheshet: zot omeret, "gargeran" ditnan — asur.
Rav ashe amar: nehi dechad asar la bae shimmur, asiri miha bae shimmur.
Shelosha yamim temein ushelosha yamim tehorin, meshammeshet shene yamim, veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam.
Arbaa yamim temeim, vearbaa yamim tehorin — meshammeshet yom echad, veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam.

Chamishsha yamim temeim, vachamishsha yamim tehorin — meshammeshet shelosha yamim, veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam. shishsha yamim temein, veshishsha yamim tehorin — meshammeshet chamishsha yamim, veshuv enah meshammeshet laolam.
Shiva yamim temein, veshiva yamim tehorin — meshammeshet revia yameha, mittoch esrim ushemona yamim.
Shemona yamim temein, ushemona yamim tehorin — meshammeshet chamishsha asar yom mittoch arbaim ushemona.
Hane arbesar havu!
Amar rav adda bar yitzchak: zot omeret, yeme niddatah sheen roa bahen olin lisfirat zivatah, deibbaya lehu:
b: Yeme leda sheenah roa bahen mahu sheyyaalu lisfirat zivatah?
Amar rav kahana: ta shema, raata shenayim, velashshelishi hippila, veenah yodaat ma hippila —
Hare zo sefek ziva, sefek leda.
Mevia korban, veeno neechol, vime ledatah sheen roa bahen — olin lah lisfirat zivatah.
Amar rav pappa: shane hatam, kevan deikka lememar yoledet zachar hi, vechol hane shiva yattire dekayahavinan la salki la lisfirat zivatah.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: beyoledet zachar ikka lesappoke, beyoledet nekeva lekka lesappoke? ella lav shema minna olin, shema minna.
Tisha yamim temein, vetisha yamim tehorin — meshammeshet shemona yamim mittoch shemona asar.
Asara yamim temein vaasara yamim tehorim — yeme shimmushah kime zivatah, vechen lemea vechen leelef.
Hadaran alach ba siman.

Mishna dam hannidda, uvesar hammet — metammein lachin, umetammein yeveshin. aval hazzov, vehannia, veharok, vehashsheretz, vehannevela, (vehashshichvat) [veshichvat] zera — metammein lachin, veen metammein yeveshin. veim yecholin lehishsharot velachzor lichmot shehen — metammein lachin umetammein yeveshin.
Vechamma hi sheriyyaytan? befoshrin meet leet. rabbi yose omer: besar hammet yavesh, veeno yachol lehishsharot velachzor lichmot shehaya — tahor.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar chizkiyya: deamar kera "vehaddava beniddatah" — madveha kemotah, ma hi metammea, af madveha metammea.
Ashkechan lach, yavesh menalan? amar rabbi yitzchak: amar kera "yihye" — bahavayato yehe.

Veema: hane mille belach venaasa yavesh, yavesh meikkaro menalan? vetu, ha ditnan: hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin afar, kemin saara, kemin yavchushin adummim — tatil lammayim, im nimmochu tame, menalan? "yihye" — ribbuya hu.
I ma hi osa mishkav umoshav letamme adam uletamme begadim, af damah name ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam uletamme begadim? attu dama bar mishkav umoshav hu?!
Uletamaych, even menuggaat bat mishkav umoshav hi, deitzterich kera lemaote? detanya: yachol tehe even menuggaat osa mishkav umoshav, letamme adam letamme begadim.
Vedin hu: uma zav, sheeno metamme bevia, ose mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim. even menuggaat, shemmetammea bevia, eno din shemmetammea mishkav umoshav letamme adam letamme begadim!
Talmud lomar "hazzav" — "hazzav" velo even menuggaat. tama demaatay kera, ha lav hachi metammea.
Uminna: lav mi amrat "hazzav" — velo even menuggaat, hachi name amar kera "asher hi yoshevet alav" — hi, velo damah.

a: I ma hi metammea beeven mesama, af madveha name metammea beeven mesama?
Amar rav ashe: amar kera "vehannose otam" — "otam" miuta hu.
Uvesar hammet, menalan? amar resh lakish: amar kera "lechol tumato" — lechol temaot happorshot mimmennu.
Rabbi yochanan amar: "o veetzem adam o vekaver" — adam dumeya deetzem: ma etzem yavesh, af kan yavesh.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deipperich ipperoche.
Metivi: besar hammet shehuferach tahor! hatam deakmach vehave afra.
Metivi: kol shebbammet metamme, chutz min hashshinnayim, vehassear, vehatztzipporen, uvishat chibburan — hakkol tame!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: dumeya deetzem, ma etzem shennivra immo, af kol shennivra immo. vehaikka sear vetzipporen, shennivreu immo utehorin!

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava: dumeya deetzem, ma etzem shennivra immo veen gizo machlif, af kol shennivra immo veen gizo machlif. yatzu hashshinnayim — shello nivreu immo, yatzu sear vetzipporen — sheaf al pi shennivreu immo, gizo machlif.

Vahare or, degizo machlif, utenan: haggeluda — rabbi meir machshir vachachamim poslin. vaafillu rabbanan la kafasli ella deaddehache vehache shalet ba avvera umita, uleolam gizo machlif. utenenan: ellu sheorotehem kivsaran — or haadam!
Ha ittemar ala, amar ulla: devar tora — or adam tahor, umay tama amru tame? gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin lachamor.
Veikka deamri: hare or, deen gizo machlif, utenan: vachachamim poslin, vaafillu rabbi meir la ka machshar ella dekarir bisra vechaye, uleolam en gizo machlif. veamar ulla: devar tora or adam tahor!

Ki ittemar deulla assefa ittemar, "vechullan sheibbedan o shehillech bahen kede avoda tehorin, chutz meor adam", veamar ulla: devar tora or adam ki ibbedo tahor, uma taam amru tame? gezera shemma yaase adam or aviv veimmo shetichin.
Vahare basar, degizo machlif, vetame! amar mar bar rav ashe: basar naase mekomo tzalleket.
Aval hazzov. zov menalan? detanya: "zovo tame" — limmed al hazzov shehu tame.

Vahalo din hu: laacherim gorem tumea, leatzmo lo kol shekken? sair hammishtalleach yochiach, sheggorem tumea laacherim, vehu atzmo tahor. af atta al titma al ze, sheaf al pi sheggorem tumea laacherim — hu atzmo tahor. talmud lomar "zovo tame" — limmed al hazzov shehu tame.
Veema: hane mille bemagga, aval bemassa la, midde dehave ashsheretz! amar rav bivi bar abbaye: bemagga la itzterich kera, dela gara mishshichvat zera,
b: Ki itzterich kera lemassa. veema: bemassa metamme adam uvegadim, uvemagga adam metamme begadim la letamme, midde dehave ammagga nevela!
La salka datach, detanya: acherim omrim: "hazzav et zovo lazzachar velannekeva" — makkish zovo lo, ma hu lo chillakta ben maggao lemassao letamme adam uletamme begadim, af zovo ken.
Vehasheta denafka lan mehazzav et zovo", "zovo tame" lema li?
Amar rav yehuda middiskarta: itzterich, salka datach amena sair hammishtalleach yochiach, sheggorem tumea laacherim vehu atzmo tahor. vei mishshum "hazzav et zovo", leminyayna hu daata.
"Zov" — chad, "zovo" — tarte, uvashshelishi akkesheh rachamana linkeva!
Ketav rachamana "zovo tame". vehasheta deamar rachamana "zovo tame hu", derosh beh name hay.
Veharok. rok menalan? detanya: "vechi yarok" — yachol af al pi shello naga? talmud lomar: "battahor" — ad sheyyigga battahor.
En li ella rukko, kicho venio ume haaf shello minnayin? talmud lomar "vechi yarok".
Amar mar: yachol af al pi shello naga? mehecha tete?
Salka datach amena, nelaf "rok" "rok" mivama — ma hatam, af al pi dela nega, af hacha name dela nega, ka mashma lan.
Veemar: hane mille bemagga, aval bemassa — la, mide dehave ashsheretz! amar resh lakish: tana deve rabbi yishmael, amar kera: "battahor" — ma shebbeyad tahor timmeti lach.
Veema: bemassa metamme adam uvegadim, bemagga adam letamme begadim la letamme, midde dehave ammagga nevela!
Amar resh lakish, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: amar kera "battahor" — tohora shettiharti lecha bemakom acher, timmeti lecha kan, veeze ze? magga nevela.
Veema kemassa desheretz! im ken nichtov kera "baadam", may "battahor"? shema minna tarte.

Ume haaf. may me haaf? amar rav: benigrarin derech happe, lefi shei efshar leme haaf belo tzichtzuche harok. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu benigrarin derech hachotem. alma kasavar: mayayn hu, verachamana rabbeyeh.
Verav, nachshov name dimat eno! deamar rav: hay man devae delistamme (leeneh) — lichchol miggoy. velevi amar: hay man devae delemut — lichchol miggoy.
Veamar rav chiyyay bar gureya: may tama derav dela amar ha "man devae delemut", hoil veyachol legorran ulehotzian derech happe? verav: nehi dezihara nafek, dimata gufa la nafek.

Ta shema: tisha mashke hazzav hen — hazzea, vehallecha serucha, veharei — tehorin mikkelum; dimat eno, vedam maggefato, vachalev haishsha — metammein tumeat mashkin birviit; aval zovo, rukko, umeme raglav — metammein tumea chamura; veillu "me haaf" la katane.
Bishlama lerav, la katane dela pesika leh lemitne, zimnin deate derech happe, vezimnin deate derech hachotem, ella lerabbi yochanan litne.
Uletamaych, "kicho venio" mi katane? ella tena rok, vechol deate meribbuya. hacha name tena rukko, vechol deate meribbuya.

Dimat eno — dichtiv "vattashkemo bidmaot shalish". vedam maggefato — dichtiv "vedam chalalim yishte". ma li katleh kulleh, ma li katleh palgeh. chalev haishsha — dichtiv "vattiftach et nood hechalav vattashkehu".
Meme raglav — menalan? detanya: "zovo tame... vezot" — lerabbot meme raglav letumea. vahalo din hu: uma rok habba mimmekom tohora tame, meme raglav habbain

a: Mimmakom tame — eno din sheyyehu temein? dam hayyotze mippi haamma yochiach, shebba mimmakom tame vetahor. af atta al titma al ze, sheaf al pi shebba mimmekom tumea yihye tahor. talmud lomar: "zovo tame... vezot" — lerabbot meme raglav letumea.

Dam hayyotze mippi haamma, menalan detahor? detanya: yachol yehe dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma temein? talmud lomar "zovo tame hu" — hu tame, veen dam hayyotze mippiv umippi haamma tame, ella tahor.
Veefoch ana! amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: dumeya derok, ma rok shemmitaggel veyotze, af kol shemmitaggel veyotze. yatza dam sheen mitaggel veyotze.
Vahare chalav shebbaishsha, shemmitaggel veyotze, veamar mar: chalav shebbaishsha metamme tumeat mashkin. tumeat mashkin — in, aval la tumea chamura!

Ella amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: dumeya derok, ma rok mitaggel veyotze, vechozer venivla — af kol mitaggel veyotze, vechozer venivla. yatza dam, sheeno mitaggel veyotze. yatza chalav shebbaishsha, sheaf al pi shemmitaggel veyotze — eno chozer venivla.
Venelaf mizzovo", ma "zovo" sheen mitaggel veyotze metamme, af kol! amar rava: mizzovo" lekka lemelaf, shekken gorem tumea laacherim.
Vehashsheretz. amar resh lakish: "sheretz sheyyavash veshildo kayyemet" — tame. vehaanan tenan: metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin! amar rabbi zera: la kashya, ha — bechullan, ha — bemiktzatan.
Detanya, amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi bisna, amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: "bahem" — yachol bechullan, talmud lomar "mehem".
I mehem — yachol bemiktzatan, talmud lomar "bahem". ha ketzad? kan — belach, kan — beyavesh.
Amar rava: hane zevuge demachoza, ki shildan kayyemet — temein. veamar resh lakish: sheretz shennisraf veshildo kayyemet — tame.
Metivi: nimtza sheretz saruf al gabbe hazzetim, vechen matlet hammehuha — tehorin, shekkol hattemaot kishat metziatan! amar rabbi zera: la kashya — ha bechullan, ha bemiktzatan.
Detanya, amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi bisna mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: "bahem" — yachol bechullan? talmud lomar "mehem".
I "mehem" — yachol bemiktzatan? talmud lomar "bahem". ha ketzad? kan — besaruf, kan — besheeno saruf.
Metammein lachin. zav — dichtiv "rar besaro", kicho venio verukko — dichtiv "ki yarok hazzav", keen rok.
Sheretz — "bemotam" amar rachamana, keen mita. shichvat zera haruya lehazeria, nevela — dichtiv "ki yamut" — keen mita.
Im yecholin lehishsharot. bae rabbi yirmeya: techillato vesofo befoshrin, o dilma techillato af al pi sheen sofo?
Ta shema, detanya: kamma hi sheriyyaytan befoshrin? yehuda ben nakosa omer: meet leet, techillato af al pi sheen sofo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: tzerichin sheyyehu poshrin meet leet.

Rabbi yose omer: besar hammet kulei. amar shemuel: tahor milletamme bichzayit, aval metamme tumeat rakav. tanya name hachi: rabbi yose omer: besar hammet sheyyavash veen yachol lishrot velachazor kemot shehaya — tahor milletamme bichzayit, aval tame tumeat rakav.
Mishna hashsheretz shennimtza bammavoy — metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar: "badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya bo sheretz", o ad sheat kibbud.
Vechen ketem shennimtza bechaluk — metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar "badakti et hechaluk hazze velo haya bo ketem", o ad sheat hakkibbus.
Umetamme ben lach, ben yavesh. rabbi shimon omer: hayyavesh metamme lemafrea, vehallach eno metamme ella ad sheat sheyyehe yachol lachazor velihyot lach.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: "ad sheat kibbud" — chezkato baduk, o dilma chezkato mitkabbed?
Umay nafka minna? deamar: "kabbuyd vela beduyk". i amrat chezkato baduk — ha la bedik, i amrat chezkato mitkabbed — ha mitkabbed.
b: I name deishtechach begumma, i amrat chezkato baduk — man devadek begumma name badek, i amrat chezkato mitkabbed — gumma la mitkabbeda.
Vechen hakketem vechulei. ibbaya lehu: ad sheat kibbus — chezkato baduk, o dilma chezkato mitkabbes?
Lemay nafka minna? deamar: kaybus vela beduk. i amrat chezkato baduk — ha la bedik, i amrat chezkato mitkabbes — ha mitkabbes.
I name, deishtechach besitra. i amrat: "chezkato baduk" — man devadek, besitra name badek. i amrat: "chezkato mitkabbes" — besitra la mitkabbes.

May? ta shema, detanya: amar rabbi meir: mippene ma amru hashsheretz shennimtza bemavoy metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar "badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya bo sheretz", o ad sheat kibbud, mippene shechezkat bene yisrael bodkin mevootehen bishat kibbudehem, veim lo badku hifsiduhu lemafrea.

Umippene ma amru, ketem shennimtza bechaluk metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar "badakti et hechaluk velo haya bo ketem", o ad sheat hakkibbus — mippene shechezkat benot yisrael bodkot chalukehen bishat kibbusehen, veim lo badku hifsidu lemafrea.
Rabbi acha amar: tachzor utechabbesennu, im (nidcha marito) [nidchu marav] — beyadua shelleachar kibbus, veim lav — beyadua shellifne hakkibbus.
Rabbi omer: eno dome ketem shelleachar hakkibbus lechetem shellifne hakkibbus, shezze makdir veze maglid. shema minna: chezkato baduk, shema minna.
Umetamme ben lach vechulei. amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella sheretz, aval ketem lach name metamme lemafrea, emar yavesh haya umayya nefuyl aleh.
Sheretz name, emar yavesh haya umayya nefuyl aleh! im ita dehachi hu — immartute immartat.

Mishna kol hakketamin habbain merkam — tehorin, rabbi yehuda metamme mippene shehem gerim vetoin. habbain mibben haggoyim — tehorin, mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim — rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharim mippene shello nechshedu al kitmehen.
Gemara kafasek vetane: afillu mittarmod! amar rabbi yochanan: zot omeret, mekabbelin gerim mittarmod.
Ini? veha rabbi yochanan vesavayya, deamri tarvayyhu: en mekabbelin gerim mittarmod!
Vechi tema, "zot" vela sevira leh, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna!
Amorae ninhu, veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Mibben yisrael vechulei. verabbanan, i deyisrael metahari, deman metammu?
Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: mibben yisrael — tame, mibben hakkutim — rabbi meir metamme, dechutim gere emet hen, vachachamim metaharin, dechutim gere arayot hen.
I hachi, shello nechshedu al kitmehen? gere arayot mibbae leh!
Ella hachi kaamar: mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim — temein, dechutim gere emet hen. hannimtzain beare yisrael — tehorin, shello nechshedu al kitmehem, veatznoe matznei lehu.
Hannimtzain beare kutim — rabbi meir metamme, denechshedu al kitmehem, vachachamim metaharin, shello nechshedu al kitmehen.
Mishna kol hakketamim hannimtzaim bechol makom — tehorin, chutz min hannimtzaim bachadarim, uvisvivot bet hattemaot.
Bet hattemaot shel kutim metammein beohel, mippene shehem kovrin sham et hannefalim. rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu kovrin, ella mashlichin, vechayya gorarto.
Neemanim lomar "kavarnu sham et hannefalim", o "lo kavarnu", neemanim lomar al habbehema im bikkera im lo bikkera, neemanim al tziyyun kevarot.
Veen neemanin lo al hassechachot, velo al happeraot, velo al bet happeras.
Ze hakkelal: davar shechashudim bo — en neemanin alav.

a: Gemara may derush? "lo tassig gevul reacha asher gavlu rishonim benachalatcha".
Kol sheyyesh lo nachala — yesh lo gevul, kol sheen lo nachala — en lo gevul.
Neemanim lomar kavarnu. veha let lehu "velifne ivver lo titten michshol"! amar rabbi avahu: bechohen omed sham.
Vedilma kohen tame hu? denaket teruma bideh, vedilma teruma temea hi? dekaachel minna.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: la bekii bitzira, ka mashma lan.
Neemanin al habbehema vechulei. veha let lehu "velifne ivver lo titten michshol"! amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: begozez veoved.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: la bekii betinnuf, ka mashma lan.
Neemanin al tziyyun vechulei. veaf al gav demidderabbanan hu, kevan dichtiva — mizhar zehiri beh, dichtiv: "veraa etzem adam uvana etzlo tziyyun".
Aval en neemanin lo al hassechachot vechulei. sechachot — ditnan: "ellu hen sechachot — ilan hammesech al haaretz". peraot — ditnan: "avanim peruot hayyotzot min haggader".
Bet happeras. amar rav yehuda amar rav shemuel: menappeach adam bet happeras, veholech.

Rav yehuda bar amme mishshemeh derav yehuda amar: bet happeras shenniddash tahor. vetana: hachoresh bet hakkevarot — hare ze ose bet happeras, vead kamma hu ose? melo maana, mea amma, bet arbaat sein. rabbi yose omer: chamesh.
Vela mehemni? vehatanya: sade sheavad bah kever, neeman kuti lomar "en sham kever".
Lefi sheeno meid ella al gufo shel kever. ilan shehu mesech al haaretz — neeman lomar "en tachtav kever", lefi sheeno meid ella al gufo shel kever.
Amar rabbi yochanan: bimhallech uva al pene kullah.
I hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: retzua nafka, ka mashma lan.
Ze hakkelal kulei. ze hakkelal leetoye may? leetoye techumin veyen nesech.
Hadaran alach dam hannidda.
b: Mishna haroa ketem al besara keneged bet hatturepa — temea, veshello keneged bet hatturepa — tehora. al akevah veal rosh gudalah — temea.
Al shokah veal parsoteha — mibbifnim temea, mibbachutz tehora, veal hatztzedadin mikkan umikkan tehora.
Raata al chalukah min hechagur ulematta — temea, min hechagur ulemala — tehora. raata al bet yad shel chaluk, im maggia keneged bet hatturepa — temea, veim lav — tehora.
Hayta poshatto umitkassa bo ballayla, kol makom shennimtza bo ketem — temea, mippene shehu chozer, vechen bappuleyos.
Gemara amar shemuel: badka karka olam, veyashva aleha, umatza dam aleha — tehora, shenneemar "bivsarah" — ad shettargish bivsarah.
Hay "bivsarah" mibbee leh, shemmetammea bifnim kevachutz! im ken, lema kera "bevasar", may "bivsarah"? shema minna: ad shettargish bivsarah.
Veakkatti mibbee leh "bivsarah", velo beshafir velo bachaticha! tarte shema minna.
Ta shema: haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha, veraata dam. rabbi meir omer: im omedet — temea, veim yoshevet — tehora.
Hechi dame? i deargisha — yoshevet ammay tehora? ella lav dela argisha, vekatane: omedet temea!
Leolam deargisha, veemor "haregashat me raglayim havay". omedet — hadur me raglayim lemakor (veayyti) [veayyto] dam, veyoshevet — tehora.
Ta shema: ed shehaya natun tachat hakkar, venimtza alav dam — im agol tahor, veim mashuch tame.
Hechi dame? i deargisha — agol ammay tahor? ella lav dela argisha, vekatane: mashuch tame.
La, leolam deargisha, veemor "haregashat ed havay", mashuch — vadday miggufa ata, agol — tahor.
Ta shema: nimtza al shello — temein, vechayyayvin bekorban. nimtza al shellah otyom — temein, vechayyayvin bekorban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman — temeim missafek, ufeturin min hakkorban.

Hechi dame? i deargisha, leachar zeman ammay peturin min hakkorban? ella lav dela argisha, vekatane nimtza al shellah otyom temein vechayyayvin bekorban! la, leolam deargisha, veema haregashat shammash hava.
Ta shema: nimtzeta atta omer shelosha sefekot baishsha — al besara, safek tame safek tahor — tame. al chalukah, safek tame safek tahor — tahor. uvemaggaot uvehessetot, hallech achar harov.
May "hallech achar harov"? lav im rov yameha temein — temea, veaf al gav dela argisha.
La, im rov yameha beharegasha chazya — temea, deemor argisha velav addata.
Amar mar: al besara safek tame safek tahor — tame, al chalukah safek tame safek tahor — tahor.

Hechi dame? i mechagor ulematta, al chalukah ammay tahor? veha tenan: min hechagur ulematta tame! vei mechagor ulemala, al besarah ammay tame? vehatnan: raata dam al besara shello keneged bet hatturepa tehora!

Ibbaet ema mechagor ulematta, veibbaet ema mechagor ulemala. i baet ema mechagor ulematta, kegon sheavra beshuk shel tabbachim. al besara — miggufa atay, dei mealma atay — al chalukah mibbee leh ishtechoche. al chalukah — mealma ata, dei miggufa ata — al besara mibbee leh ishtechoche.

Veibbaet ema, mechagor ulemala, kegon deizdekara al besarah — vadday miggufa atay, dei mealma atay — al chalukah ibbei leh ishtechoche. al chalukah — mealma atay, dei miggufa atay — al besara ibbei leh ishtechoche.

Katane mihat: al besarah safek tame safek tahor tame, veaf al gav delo hirgisha. veod tenan: haroa ketem al besara keneged bet hatturepa temea, veaf al gav delo hirgisha. amar rav yirmeya middifti: mode shemuel shehi temea

a: Midderabbanan.
