Rav ashe amar: shemuel hu deamar kerabbi nechemya, ditnan: rabbi nechemya omer: kol davar sheeno mekabbel tumea — eno mekabbel ketamim.
Bishlama lerav ashe — hayeynu dekaamar "karka", ella lerav yirmeya — may irya karka? afillu gelima name! la mibbaya kaamar.
La mibbaya gelima, dela mibbedak shappir, veikka lememar mealma ata, ella afillu karka demibbedak shappir, deikka lememar miggufa atya — tahor.
Al akevah veal rosh gudalah temea vechulei. bishlama akevah, avid denaga beoto makom, ella rosh gudalah may tama? vechi tema zimnin denaga baakevah, umi mechazzekinan tumea mimmakom lemakom?
Vehatanya: hayta lah makka betzavvarah, shettuchal litlot — tola, al ketefah, sheenah yechola litlot — enah tola.
Veen omrim "shemma beyadah netalattu veheviattu lesham"! ella shane rosh gudalah, devahade defasa avid demitreme.
Vela mechazzekinan tumea mimmakom lemakom? vehatanya: nimtzet al kishre etzbeoteha — temea, mippene sheyyadayim askaniyyot hen.
May tama? lav mishshum deamrinan: badka bechad yeda, venaga beiddach yeda? la, shane yeda, dechulla avida denaga.
Al shokah veal parsoteha, mibbifnim vechulei. mibbifnim — ad hecha? amri deve rabbi yannay: ad makom chavak.

Ibbaya lehu: mekom chavak kelifnim o kelachutz? ta shema, detane rav kattina: ad mekom chavak, vachavak atzmo kelifnim. rav chiyyay bereh derav avya matne la behedya, amri deve rabbi yannay: ad makom chavak, vachavak atzmo kelifnim.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: "kesher" mahu? "keshura" mahu? "tippin tippin" mahu? "lerochav yerechah" mahu?
Ta shema: al besarah, safek tame safek tahor — tame. al besarah — may lav ki hay gavvna? la, dilma daavid kirtzua.
Hahi itteta deishtechach la dema bemashtita, atay lekammeh derabbi yannay, amar la: tezil vetete.
Vehatanya: en shonin bitharot! ki amrinan en shonin — lekulla, aval lechumera — shonin.
Hayta poshatto vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: davar ze horeti bair romi leissur, ucheshebbati etzel chachamim shebbaddarom amru li: yafe horetah.

Tanu rabbanan: arukka shellavsha chalukah shel ketzara, uketzara shellavsha chalukah shel arukka — im maggia keneged bet hatturepa shel arukka, shetehen temeot. veim lav, arukka tehora uketzara temea.
Tanya iddach: badka chalukah vehishilattu lachavertah, hi tehora vachavertah tola bah. amar rav sheshet: uleinyan dina tenan, aval leinyan tumea — hi tehora vachavertah temea.
b: May shena meha detanya: shete nashim shennitasseku betzippor echad, veen bo ella kesela dam, venimtza kesela al zo uchesela al zo — shetehen temeot? shane hatam deikka sela yattira.
Tanu rabbanan: lavsha shelosha chalukot habbedukin lah, im yechola litlot — tola, vaafillu battachton. en yechola litlot — enah tola, vaafillu baelyon.
Ketzad? avra beshuk shel tabbachim — tola afillu battachton; lo avra beshuk shel tabbachim — af baelyon enah tola.
Mishna vetola bechol davar shehi yechola litlot. shachata behema, chayya vaof, nitasseka bichtamim, o sheyyashva betzad haasukin bahen, harga maacholet — hare zo tola bah.
Ad kamma tola? rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: ad kigris shel pol, veaf al pi shello harga. vetola bivnah o bevalah im yesh bah makka, vehi yechola lehiggalea ulehotzi dam — hare zo tola.

Maase beishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva, amra lo: raiti ketem. amar lah: shemma makka hayta bich? amra lo: hen. vechayta, amar lah: shemma yechola lehiggalea ulehotzi dam? amra lo: hen. vetiharah rabbi akiva.

Raa talmidav mistakkelin ze baze, amar lahem: ma haddavar kashe beenechem? shello amru chachamim haddavar lehachemir ella lehakel, shenneemar: "veishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah" — "dam" velo ketem.
Ed shehu natun tachat hakkar, venimtza alav dam — agol tahor, mashuch tame; divre rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok.
Gemara tenena leha detanu rabbanan: maase vetala rabbi meir bekilor, verabbi tala bisraf shikma.
O sheyyashva. yashva — in, lo yashva — la.
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: avra beshuk shel tabbachim, safek nittaz aleha safek lo nittaz aleha — tola, safek avra safek lo avra — temea.

Harga maacholet. harga — in, lo harga — la. matnitin manni? rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, detanya: harga — tola, lo harga — enah tola, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach tola.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lidvaray — en ketz, uledivre chaveray — en sof.
Lidvaray en ketz — sheen lecha ishsha shettehora levalah, sheen lecha kol mitta umitta sheen bah kamma tippe dam maacholet.
Ledivre chaveray en sof — sheen lecha ishsha sheenah tehora levalah, sheen lecha kol sadin vesadin sheen bo kamma tippe dam.

Aval nirin divre rabbi chanina ben antignos middevaray umiddivrehem, shehaya omer: ad kamma hi tola? ad kigris shel pol. velidvarav anu modim. ulerabbanan deamri tola, ad kamma? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tola befishpesh, vead ketormos.
Tanu rabbanan: pishpesh ze, orko kerochbo, vetamo kerecho. berit keruta lo, shekkol hammollo meriach bo. orko kerochbo — leinyan ketamim;
Tamo kerecho — leinyan teruma. ditnan: o shettaam taam pishpesh befiv, hare ze yiflot. mena yada? tamo kerecho. veakkatti mena yada? berit keruta lo, shekkol hammollo meriach bo.
Amar rav ashe: ir sheyyesh bah chazirim, en choshshin lichtamim. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: veha derokeret keir sheyyesh bah chazirim damya.
Ad kamma hi tola vechulei. amar rav huna: kigris — enah tola, pachot mikkigris — tola, verav chisda amar: kigris — tola, yater mikkigris — enah tola.
Lema, bead vead bichlal ka mippalgi, derav huna savar: ad velo ad bichlal, verav chisda savar: ad vead bichlal?
Amar lecha rav huna: ikka ad vead bichlal, veikka ad velo ad bichlal, vehacha lechumera, vehacha lechumera.
Verav chisda amar lach: bealma ema lach lechumera amrinan, lekulla la amrinan. vehacha kidrabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: kol shiure chachamim lehachemir, chutz mikkigris shel ketamim lehakel.
Ikka deamri la leha shemata beappe nafsha: rav huna amar — kigris keyater mikkigris, verav chisda amar — kigris kefachot mikkigris, vekamippalgi bead vead" dehacha, kidamrinan. metivi:

a: Hayu aleha tippe damim lematta vetippe damim lemala — tola beelyon ad kigris. may lav kigris millematta? la, kigris millemala.
Ittemar: nimtza aleha kigris vaod, veoto od retzufa bo maacholet. rabbi chanina omer: temea, rabbi yannay omer: tehora. rabbi chanina omer temea — ki talya bechigris, bechigris vaod la talya.

Rabbi yannay omer: tehora, hane mille — hecha delo retzufa bo maacholet, aval hecha dirtzufa bo maacholet — mochcha milleta dehay vaod dam maacholet hu, pash leh kigris, kevan divalma talya — hacha name talya.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: nitasseka bechigris, venimtza aleha bechigris vaod, mahu? tive lerabbi chanina, tive lerabbi yannay.

Tibbee lerabbi chanina: ad kan la kaamar rabbi chanina hatam "temea" ella delo nitasseka, aval hacha denitasseka — talya? o dilma, afillu lerabbi yannay deamar "tehora" — hane mille hecha dirtzufa bo maacholet, aval hecha deen retzufa bo maacholet — lo talya?
Ta shema: nitasseka beedom — en tola bah shachor, bemuat — en tola bo merubba. hechi dame? lav ki hay gavvna?!
La, kegon denitasseka bechigris, venimtza aleha shene gerisin vaod. i hachi, may lememra?
Mahu detema: shekol kigris (tzippor), shedi be mitze; zil hacha — lekka shiura, zil hacha — lekka shiura, ka mashma lan.
Amar rava: nimtza aleha min echad — tola bo kamma minin. metivi: nitasseka beadom — en tola bo shachor! nitasseka shane.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: nitasseka bemin echad — tola bo kamma minin. metivi: nitasseka beadom — en tola bo shachor! ki kaamar rava, deitassaka betarnegolet deit ba kamma mine dema.
Maase beishsha [vechulei]. vehatanya: lo amru chachamim et haddavar lehakel ella lehachemir!
Amar ravina: lo lehakel al divre tora, ella lehachemir al divre tora, uchetamim atzman derabbanan.
Ed shehu natun, ibbaya lehu: mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, o la?
Ta shema: ketem aroch — mitztaref, tippin tippin — en mitztarfin. manni? i rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok — lema li tzeruf? haamar "mashuch kol shehu tame"!
Ella lav rabbanan, shema minna peligi? la, leolam rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, vechi amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok — beed, aval bechetem — la.
Ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok. halacha — mikkelal difligi, shema minna.
Hadaran alach haroa ketem.
b: Mishna haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam, rabbi meir omer: im omedet — temea, veim yoshevet — tehora. rabbi yose omer: ben kach uven kach tehora.
Ish veishsha sheasu tzorchehen letoch hassefel, venimtza dam al hammayim — rabbi yose metaher, verabbi shimon metamme, sheen derech haish lehotzi dam, ella shechezkat damim min haishsha.
Gemara may shena omedet, deamrinan: me raglayim hadur lemakor veayyti dam? yoshevet name nema: me raglayim hadur lemakor veayyti dam!
Amar shemuel: bimzanneket. mezanneket name, dilma batar detammu mayya ata dam?
Amar rabbi abba: beyoshevet al sefat hassefel, umezanneket betoch hassefel, venimtza dam betoch hassefel, deim ita devatar detammu mayya ata — al sefat hassefel ibbei leh leishtechoche.
Amar shemuel, veamri la amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose, vechen ori leh rabbi abba lekala halacha kerabbi yose.
Ish veishsha [vechulei]. ibbaya lehu: ish veishsha omdin, ma li amar rabbi meir?
Ki amar rabbi meir bechad sefeka, aval bisfek sefeka la metamme, o dilma la shena?
Amar resh lakish: hi hi. mimmay? middela katane "rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin".
I hachi, hasheta rabbi meir bisfek sefeka metamme, bechad sefeka mibbaya? lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose, daafillu bechad sefeka metaher.
Veaddemippalgi bechad safek, lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose, liflegu bisfek sefeka, lehodiacha kocho derabbi meir! koach dehettera adif leh.

Verabbi yochanan amar: ki kaamar rabbi meir bechad sefeka, aval bisfek sefeka la amar. im ken, litne "rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin"! in hachi name, veayyeyde desalek merabbi yose — patach bidrabbi yose.
Verabbi yose bechad sefeka metaher, bisfek sefeka mibbaya? mahu detema: hane mille diavad, aval lechattechilla la, ka mashma lan.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: ish veishsha sheasu tzorchehen letoch hassefel, venimtza dam al hammayim — rabbi meir verabbi yose metaharin, verabbi shimon metamme.
Ibbaya lehu: ishsha yoshevet, ma li amar rabbi shimon? ki amar rabbi shimon beomedet, didchik la alma, aval yoshevet — la, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema, detanya: yoshevet — tola, omedet — enah tola, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: ben kach uven kach — tola. rabbi shimon omer: ben kach uven kach — enah tola.
Ibbaya lehu: ish veishsha yoshvin, ma li amar rabbi shimon? ki amar rabbi shimon — omedet didchik la alma, veyoshevet dechad safek, aval bisfek sefeka — la amar, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema: kevan deamar rabbi shimon "chezkat damim min haishsha" — la shena omdin vela shena yoshvin.
Mishna hishila chalukah lenochrit o lenidda — hare zo tola bah.
Shalosh nashim shellavshu chaluk echad, o sheyyashvu al safsal echad, venimtza alav dam — kullan temeot.
Yashvu al safsal shel even o al haitzteva shel merchatz — rabbi nechemya metaher. shehaya rabbi nechemya omer: kol davar sheeno mekabbel tumea — eno mekabbel ketamim.
Gemara amar rav: benochrit

a: Haroa.
Mimmay? dumeya denidda: ma nidda dekachazya, af nochrit deka chazya.
Amar rav sheshet: ki nayem veshachev rav amra leha shemata. detanya: tola benochrit. rabbi meir omer: benochrit haruya lirot. vaafillu rabbi meir la kaamar ella biruya lirot, aval roa — la itzterich.
Amar rava: vetisbera rabbi meir lechumera? rabbi meir lekulla!
Detanya: enah tola benochrit, rabbi meir omer: tola. veella kashya hach! taretz hachi: vehi sheroa. rabbi meir omer: biruya lirot, veaf al pi sheenah roa.
Tanu rabbanan: tola beshomeret yom keneged yom, bashsheni shellah.
Uvesoferet shiva shello tavla, lefichach hi metukkenet vachavertah mekulekelet, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. rabbi omer: enah tola, lefichach shetehen mekulekalot.
Veshavin, shettola beshomeret yom keneged yom, barishon shellah.
Uveyoshevet al dam tohar, uvivtula sheddameha tehorin.
"Lefichach" derabban shimon ben gamliel — lema li? mishshum derabbi.
"Lefichach" derabbi — lema li? mahu detema: hahi deishtechach ketem gabba — titkalkal, iddach — lo titkalkal; kamashma lan.
Amar rav chisda: tame vetahor shehalchu bishne shevilin, echad tahor veechad tame — banu lemachloket rabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel.
Matkef la rav adda: ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam, ella detarvayyhu ki hadade ninhu, hacha may nafka lan minna?
Verav chisda, sof sof ihi tevila baaya.
Ittemar, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: tame vetahor, vaafillu tahor vetaluy, shehalchu bishne shevilin, echad tame veechad tahor — tole tame betaluy vetahor betahor, ledivre hakkol.
Bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yehuda bar levay: mahu litlot ketem bechetem? allibba derabbi — la tibbee lach.
Hasheta, uma hatam deka chazya miggufa, amrat enah tola, hacha demealma ka ate — lo kol shekken?
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabban shimon ben gamliel, hatam hu deka chazya miggufa — talya, hacha demealma kaate — la talya, o dilma la shena.
Amar leh: en tolin. ma taam? lefi sheen tolin.
Etiveh: en tolin ketem bechetem, hishila chalukah lenochrit o leyoshevet al hakketem — hare zo tola bah.
Ha gufa kashya: resha amrat en tolin, sefa amrat tolin! ha la kashya — ha rabbi, veha rabban shimon ben gamliel.
Ikka deamri: ha veha rabbi — ha barishon shellah, ha bashsheni shellah.
Rav ashe amar: ha veha rabban shimon ben gamliel — vela kashya,
b: Kan lemafrea, kan lehabba.
Mikkol makom kashya! amar ravina: la kashya, hachi kaamar: hishila chalukah lenochrit — baalat ketem hare zo tola bah.
Veha "o leyoshevet al hakketem" katane! hachi kaamar: o leyoshevet al dam tohar — baalat ketem tola bah.
Shalosh shellavshu kulei. shehaya rabbi nechemya kulei. amar rav matna: may tama derabbi nechemya? dichtiv "venikkata laaretz teshev" — kevan sheyyashva laaretz — nikkata.
Amar rav huna, amar rabbi chanina: metaher haya rabbi nechemya afillu baachore keli cheres. peshita!
Mahu detema: ligzor gabbo attu tocho, ka mashma lan.
Amar abbaye: metaher haya rabbi nechemya bematlaniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh, dela chazyayn la laaniyyim velo laashirim.
Darash rav chiyyay bar rav matna mishshemeh derav: halacha kerabbi nechemya. amar leh rav nachman: abba tane maase ba lifne chachamim vetimmeum, veat amrat halacha kerabbi nechemya?

May hi? detanya: shete nashim shehayu tochanot berechayim shel yad, venimtza dam tachat happenimit — shetehen temeot, tachat hachitzona — hachitzona temea vehappenimit tehora, benatayim — shetehen temeot.
Haya maase venimtza dam al sefatah shel ambati, veal ale shel zayit beshaa shemmassikot et hattannur, uva maase lifne chachamim vetimmeum.
Tannae hi, detanya: rabbi yaakov metamme, verabbi nechemya metaher, vehoru chachamim kerabbi nechemya.

Mishna shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat, venimtza dam tachat achat mehen — kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet temea — hi temea, ushetehen tehorot. vetolot zo bazo, veim lo hayu reuyot lirot — roin otan keillu hen reuyot.
Gemara amar rav yehuda, amar rav: vehu shebbadka atzmah beshiur veset".
Savar la kevar peda, deamar: kol shebbalah bechattat — tohoroteha temeot.
Balah beasham taluy — tohoroteha teluyot, balah patur — tohoroteha tehorot.
Verabbi oshaya amar: afillu balah bechattat — tohoroteha teluyot.
Bishlama hatam, emar shammash akkeveh ledam, [aval] hacha, im ita (dehave) [dahava] dam, man akkeveh?

Amar rabbi yirmeya: mashal derabbi oshaya, lema haddavar dome? leyeled vezaken shehayu mehallechin badderech, kol zeman shehayu badderech — yeled shohe lavo, nichnesu lair — yeled memaher lavo. veamar abbaye: mashal derabbi oshaya, lema haddavar dome? leadam shennoten etzba baayin, kol zeman sheetzba baayin — dima shoha lavo, natal haetzba — dima memaheret lavo.
Vetolot zo bazo. tanu rabbanan: ketzad tolot zo bazo? ubbara vesheenah ubbara — tola ubbara besheenah ubbara.
Menika vesheenah menika — tola menika besheenah menika. zekena vesheenah zekena — tola zekena besheenah zekena. betula vesheenah betula — tola betula besheenah betula.
Hayu shetehen ubbarot, shetehen menikot, shetehen zekenot, shetehen betulot — zo hi sheshshaninu: lo hayu reuyot lirot — roin

a: Keillu hen reuyot.

Mishna shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat, venimtza dam tachat haemtzait — kullan temeot. tachat happenimit — shetayim happenimiyyot temeot, vehachitzona tehora. tachat hachitzona — shetayim hachitzonot temeot, vehappenimit tehora.

Ematay? bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta, aval im avru derech aleha — kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet tehora — hi tehora, ushetayim temeot. badku shetayim umatzu tehorot — hen tehorot, ushelishit temea. shelashtan umatzu tehorot — kullan temeot.
Lema haddavar dome? legal tame shennitarev ben shene gallim tehorim, uvadku echad mehen umatzu tahor — hu tahor, ushenayim temeim. shenayim umatzu tehorin — hem tehorin, ushelishi tame.
Shelashtan, umatzu tehorin — kullan temeim, divre rabbi meir. sherabbi meir omer: kol davar shehu bechezkat tumea — leolam hu betumeato, ad sheyyivvada lecha tumea hechan hi.
Vachachamim omrim: bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula.
Gemara may shena resha dela mefalleg, umay shena sefa dekamfalleg? amar rabbi amme: bimshullavot.
Badka achat [vechulei]. lema leh lemitne "lema ze dome"?
Hachi kaamar lehu rabbi meir lerabbanan: may shena bedam dela peligitu, umay shena begal difligitu?
Verabbanan, bishlama hatam — ema orev netalah, ella hacha — hay dam mehecha ata?

Tanya, amar rabbi meir: maase beshikma shel kefar sava, shehayu machazikin bah tumea, uvadku velo matzu. leyamim nashva bo haruach vaakarattu, venimtza gulegolet shel met techuva lo beikkaro. amru lo: mishsham reaya? emar lo badku kol tzarko.

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: maase bimara shel shichin, shehayu machzikin bah tumea, uvadku ad shehiggiu lekarka shehayta chalaka ketzipporen, velo matzu. leyamim nichnesu bah poalim mippene haggeshamim, venittezu bekardummotehen, umatzu machteshet melea atzamot. amru lo: mishsham reaya? emar lo badku kol tzarko.

Tanya, abba shaul omer: maase besela bet choron, shehayu machazikin bah tumea, velo yachlu chachamim livdok mippene shehayta merubba. vehaya sham zaken echad, verabbi yehoshua ben chananya shemo. amar lahen: haviu li sedinim! heviu lo sedinim, usheraan bemayim, uferasan alehem. mekom tohora — yavesh, mekom tumea — lach, uvadku umatzu bor gadol male atzamot.
Tana: hu habbor shemmille yishmael ben netanya chalalim, dichtiv: "vehabbor asher hishlich sham yishmael et kol pigre anashim asher hikka beyad gedalya".
Vechi gedalya haragan? vahalo yishmael haragan! ella mittoch shehaya lo lachosh laatzat yochanan ben kareach, velo chash — maale alav hakkatuv keillu haragan.
Amar rava: hay lishshana bisha, af al pi dilkabbole la mibbee — mechash leh mibbee.

Hanhu bene galila dinfak alayyhu kala diktul nafsha, ato lekammeh derabbi tarfon, amaru leh: latmerinan mar! amar lehu: hechi naaved? i la atmerinchu — chazu yatayychu, atmerinchu — ha amur rabbanan: hay lishshana bisha, af al gav dilkabbole la mibbee — mechash leh mibbee. zilu attun, tammaru nafshayychu.
"Vayyomer Adonai el moshe al tira" — mikkede sichon veog ache havo, deamar mar: sichon veog bene achiyya bar shamchazay havo, may shena meog dekamistefe, umay shena missichon dela kamistefe?
Amar rabbi yochanan, amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: mitteshuvato shel oto tzaddik atta yodea ma haya belibbo, amar: shemma taamod lo zechut shel avraham avinu.
Shenneemar: "vayyavo happalit vayyagged leavram haivri", veamar rabbi yochanan: ze og, sheppalat middor hammabbul.
Tanu rabbanan: beged sheavad bo ketem, maavir alav shiva sammanin umevattelo. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer:
b: Bodko shechunot shechunot.
Avda bo shichvat zera, chadash — bodko bemachat, shachuk — bodko bachamma. tana: en "shechuna" pechuta mishshelosh etzbaot.
Tanu rabbanan: beged sheavad bo kilayim — hare ze lo yimkerennu legoy, velo yaasennu mardaat lachamor, aval ose mimmennu tachrichin lemet. amar rav yosef: zot omeret — mitzvot betelot leatid lavo.
Amar leh abbaye, vei tema rav dimi: veha amar rabbi mani amar rabbi yannay, lo shanu ella lesofdo, aval lekovro asur. amar leh: lav ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: afillu lekovro.
Verabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "bammetim chofshi"? kevan shemmet adam naasa chofshi min hammitzvot.
Amar rafram bar pappa, amar rav chisda: beged sheavad bo kilayim — tzovo, umuttar. amar leh rava lerafram bar pappa: mena leh lesava ha?
Amar leh: matnitin hi, ditnan: bodek ad shemmaggia lesela, vei lekka — emar orev netalah. hachi name: amra vechittana bahadade la salek lehu tziva, vechevan dela yedia — emar mintar netar.
Amar rav acha bereh derav yeva mishshemeh demar zutera: hay man dirme chuta dechittana biglimay deamra venattekeh, vela yada i netik i la netik — shappir dame.
May tama? middeorayyta "shaatnez" ketiv — ad sheyyihye shua, tevivy, venuz. verabbanan hu digzaru beh, vechevan dela yada i nattekeh — shere.
Matkef la rav ashe: emar o shua o tevivy o nuz! vehilcheta kemar zutera, middeappekinhu rachamana bachada lishshana.
Tanu rabbanan: beged tzavua metamme mishshum ketem. rabbi natan bar yosef omer: eno metamme mishshum ketem, shello tikkenu bigde tzivonin leishsha ella lehakel al kitmehen.
Tikkenu? may takkeninhu? ella, shello hutteru bigde tzivonin leishsha ella lehakel al kitmehen. "hutteru" — mikkelal daasiri!
In, ditnan: bappulemus shel aspasyanus gazru al atrot chatanim veal hairus, bikkeshu ligzor al bigde tzivonin. amri: ha adifa, kede lehakel al kitmehen.
Mishna shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem: rok tafel, ume gerisin, ume raglayim, veneter, uvorit,

a: Kimonya, veashlag.

Hitbilo veasa al gabbav teharot, heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar — hare ze tzeva, hatteharot tehorot veeno tzarich lehatebil. avar o sheddeha — hare ze ketem, vehatteharot temeot vetzarich lehatebil.
Ezehu rok tafel? kol shello taam kelum. me gerisin — leissat gerisin shel pol chalukat nefesh. me raglayim — shehechmitzu.
Vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim lechol echad veechad, heeviran shello kesidran, o sheheevir shiva sammanin keachat — lo asa velo chelum.
Gemara tana: neter alekkesanderit, velo neter antippatrit.
Borit. amar rav yehuda: ze ahala. vehatanya: habborit vehaahal! ella may borit? kavrita.

Ureminhi: hosifu alehen halebetzin, vehalleonin, habborit, vehaahal. vei borit kavrita, mi it leh sheviit? vehatnan: ze hakkelal: kol sheyyesh lo ikkar — yesh lo sheviit, vechol sheen lo ikkar — en lo sheviit! ella may borit? ahala. vehatanya: habborit vehaahal! tere gavvne ahala.
Kimonya. amar rav yehuda: shelof dotz. veashlag, amar shemuel: sheeltinhu lenachote yamma, vaamaru: ashlaga shemeh, umishtechach bene nikve marganita, umappeki le beramtza defarzela.
Hitbilo veasa [kulei]. tanu rabbanan: heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar, tzappon veavar — tohorotav temeot.
Tzappon tzeva name meabbar! ella, heevir alav shishsha sammanin velo avar, heevir alav tzappon veavar — tohorotav temeot, sheim heevir shevii mittechilla, shemma avar.
Tanya iddach: heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar, shenaan veavar — tohorotav tehorot.
Amar rabbi zera: lo shanu ella hatteharot shennaasu ben tichboset rishona lashsheniyya, aval teharot shennaasu achar tichboset sheniyya — tohorotav temeot, shehare hikpid alav veavar.
b: Amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: midde bikfida talya milleta?
Amar leh: in, detanya: rabbi chiyyay omer: dam hannidda vadday — maavir alav shiva sammanin, umevattelo.
Veammay? ha dam nidda hu! alma bikfeda talya milleta, hachi name bikfeda talya milleta.
Tenan hatam: charasin shennishtammesh bahen zav, shebbalu mashkin, venaflu laavir hattannur, vehussak hattannur — hattannur tame, shessof mashke latzet.

Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella mashkin kallim, aval mashkin chamurin — tame, af al pi shello hussak hattannur. rabbi yochanan amar: echad mashkin kallin veechad mashkin chamurin, im hussak hattannur — in, i la — la.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: hitbilo, veasa al gabbav teharot, veheevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar — hare ze tzeva, vetohorotav tehorot, veen tzarich lehatebil!
Amar leh: hannach lichtamim derabbanan.
Vehatane rabbi chiyyay: dam hannidda vadday — maavir alav shiva sammanin umevattelo!
Amar leh: rabbi lo shana, rabbi chiyyay mena leh?
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: reviit dam shennivla babbayit — habbayit tame, veamri la: habbayit tahor. vela peligi — ha bechelim demeikkara, ha bechelim devassof.
Nivlea bichsut, im mitkabbeset veyotze mimmenna reviit dam — temea, veim lav — tehora!
Amar rav kahana: mikkulle reviiyyot shanu kan, shane dam tevusa derabbanan.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: kol habbalua sheeno yachol latzet — tahor. ha yachol latzet — tame, veaf al gav dela nafek!
Amar rav pappa: kol hecha deen yachol latzet, velo hikpid alav — divre hakkol tahor; yachol latzet vehikpid alav — divre hakkol tame.
Ki peligi deyachol latzet velo hikpid alav, mar savar: kevan deyachol latzet, af al gav delo hikpid alav, umar savar: af al gav deyachol latzet
